jobs.title: Senior Backend .NET Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you an engineer who loves both setting a framework and contributing hands-on? Someone who not only writes code, but also determines the way ahead? As Senior Backend Engineer at Funda, you design, build and scale systems that help millions of potential house buyers and real estate agents every day. You work at the interface of technology, architecture and product development – and you have a voice that is listened to.

Your job in a nutshell

You are a technical heavyweight within Funda’s backend domain. You design scalable systems, improve the technical foundations of our platform and work on features that directly impact millions of users.

You have a fixed product team, but you also work across teams: you bring people, teams and ideas together to move us forward technically. With modern technology such as .NET 8, Kubernetes, Azure, event-driven architecture and Terraform, you ensure that our systems remain smart, scalable and future-ready.

What makes this role unique is the combination of technical depth, ownership and influence on how we build at Funda.

What you will do

Give direction to your team according to our lighthouse architecture and contribute to its further development.
Design and optimise critical systems that require high levels of performance and reliability.
Solve complex problems around scalability, data streams or systems integration.
Together with product managers and designers, ensure that the technical decisions align with the product vision.
Share knowledge and coach medior and junior engineers, and contribute to Funda's learning culture.
Work together with other senior and staff engineers to further develop Funda’s technical strategy.

Also read our Engineering blog:
How we use modular pipelines to empower our development team

Your team

At Funda, various scrum teams work on different parts of our platform: from improving the search experience to renewing the system with which estate real agents manage their properties.

We are currently recruiting for various teams. During the recruitment process, we will look together with you at where your knowledge, interests and ambitions would be best placed.

Whichever team you end up in, you will always work with a product manager, UX designer and various frontend and backend engineers on products that matter. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will also work a lot with our staff engineers such as Aleix: ‘My role as a Staff Engineer is to build a platform that lets you develop boldly, ship confidently, and sleep peacefully. Your job is to break it in all the best ways – to challenge assumptions, spot the cracks, and help us build something truly great together.’

Also read our Engineering blog:
How Golden Paths give our developers more time to actually develop

Why you want to become a Senior Backend .NET Engineer at Funda

You play a significant role in the realisation and further development of the technical route forward for a platform with millions of users.
You work on systems that process millions of visits every day, and that are highly demanding in terms of speed, reliability and scalability.
You have a direct impact on how potential house buyers, real estate agents and partners experience Funda.

This is you

You have broad experience with .NET Core, Azure, Kubernetes and event-driven architecture.
You have a strong vision of scalable, maintenance-friendly software and know how to transform this vision into action.
You work across teams and systems, and communicate clearly about technical choices.
You lead and coach colleagues by sharing knowledge and introducing best practices.
You feel responsible for the quality and performance of our backend systems.
You're currently living in the Netherlands and speak fluent English (Dutch is a plus).
And you have enough experience to justifiably call yourself senior level.

Love being spoiled? Well, we love spoiling you!

A salary between € 5.814,58 and € 6.486,34 per month, based on a 40 hours per week contract
Annual bonus of up to 1.5 times your monthly salary
Hybrid working: minimum 40% in the office
25 paid days off a year and the possibility to buy more
Working hours (32/36/40 per week) are negotiable
60% pension coverage
A learning budget of up to € 2000 per year
A net monthly reimbursement of up to € 85 for your phone and internet costs
A net work-from-home allowance of € 2.45 per day
Full coverage of your travel costs for office days (if you live over 5 km away)
Unlimited access to mental support via OpenUp for both work-related and personal matters, including phone consultations with psychologists
The opportunity to take an (unpaid) 3-month sabbatical every 3 years
Contribution to your membership at selected gyms and regular massages at the office
Office lunch freshly prepared by our in-house chefs for a small, legally required contribution deducted from your salary
Parties and team outings: from drinks on boats to graffiti workshops. And a present for your birthday, or just because – because why not?

Interested? Let’s go!

Apply with your CV and cover letter via the button below.
Meet one of our recruiters on a video call.
Positive? Then you can expect a maximum of two interview rounds.
Before the first round, we will ask you to do a task.

Read more about our hiring process or check our FAQ.

jobs.title: Junior Fullstack C# Developer
jobs.description:
Junior Fullstack C# Developer | Woerden

Ben jij een Junior C# Developer die graag verder wil groeien in fullstack development? Bij Mobile Keys krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan onze eigen software en producten die dagelijks door zorgorganisaties worden gebruikt.

Je werkt binnen een klein en betrokken developmentteam aan ons eigen webportaal. Je bent betrokken bij de ontwikkeling van nieuwe functionaliteiten, verbeteringen en koppelingen en krijgt daarbij de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt aan zowel de back-end als front-end van onze applicaties en houdt je onder andere bezig met:
• Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van applicaties met C# en .NET
• Werken met ASP.NET / MVC
• Ontwikkelen met HTML en JavaScript
• Werken met MS SQL
• Bouwen en verbeteren van functionaliteiten binnen ons eigen webportaal
• Meedenken over technische oplossingen en verbeteringen
• Werken met Git, Visual Studio en Azure DevOps
• Werken met CI/CD binnen Microsoft Azure
• Samenwerken met collega's tijdens onze tweewekelijkse sprints

Je werkt dus niet aan steeds wisselende klantprojecten, maar aan ons eigen softwareplatform. Daardoor zie je direct wat je ontwikkelt en hoe jouw werk in de praktijk wordt gebruikt.

Wat zoeken wij?

We zoeken iemand met een goede basis in C# en interesse in fullstack development. Je hoeft zeker nog niet alles te kunnen. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je graag wilt leren, zelfstandig kunt werken en het leuk vindt om mee te denken over hoe dingen beter kunnen.

Je hebt:

• Een opleiding in ICT of vergelijkbare relevante kennis
• Ervaring met C#
• Basiskennis van MS SQL
• Basiskennis van HTML
• Interesse in .NET en fullstack development
• Een praktische en oplossingsgerichte instelling
• Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en/of Engels

Wat bieden wij?

• Een salaris van €2.800 tot €4.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring
• Een fulltime functie in Woerden
• Mogelijkheid om gedeeltelijk vanuit huis te werken
• 25 vakantiedagen
• Reiskostenvergoeding
• Pensioenregeling
• Laptop van de zaak
• Mogelijkheden voor opleiding en verdere ontwikkeling
• Een plek binnen een klein team waar je daadwerkelijk invloed hebt op wat we bouwen

Over Mobile Keys

Mobile Keys ontwikkelt oplossingen waarmee zorgorganisaties deuren en toegang op een veilige en praktische manier kunnen beheren. Onze software en hardware worden gebruikt op locaties binnen de zorg.

Je komt terecht in een organisatie waar software niet het eindproduct op zichzelf is. Wat jij bouwt, wordt onderdeel van een oplossing die iedere dag in de praktijk wordt gebruikt.

Interesse?

Ben jij geïnteresseerd in deze functie? Stuur dan je cv rechtstreeks naar solliciteren@mobilekeys.nl. We nemen je sollicitatie vervolgens rechtstreeks met je door.

Recruitmentbureaus en recruiters: graag niet reageren en geen kandidaten aanbieden. Wij werken voor deze vacature uitsluitend rechtstreeks met sollicitanten.

As a Medior Backend .NET Engineer at Funda, you build software that helps millions of people to take the next step on the housing market every day. From quick search results to smart data coupling: you make the difference in how the Netherlands finds houses.

Your job in a nutshell

You write high-value code for a platform that is visited tens of millions of times a month. You work with modern technology such as .NET 8, Kubernetes, Azure and event-driven architecture, and ship to production every day via Azure DevOps.

You have ownership of the services and features that you build – from idea all the way to production – and work closely with colleagues to continually improve them. What makes this role unique is Funda's scale, the quality of our codebase and the freedom you get to really make an impact.

What you will do

Develop and refine features which have a direct impact on user experience, such as making search results faster or optimising the data streams of our calculation tools.

jobs.title: .NET developer
Medior Full Stack Developer (.NET)
jobs.description:
Ben jij een Full Stack Developer die niet alleen enthousiast wordt van goede code, maar vooral van software die écht iets oplost voor de business? Vind je het leuk om met collega's uit verschillende onderdelen van de organisatie om tafel te gaan, processen te begrijpen en samen slimme oplossingen te bedenken? Dan zijn wij bij Amega op zoek naar jou!

Wat
ga je doen als Full Stack Developer?

Als Medior Full Stack Developer werk je aan applicaties en oplossingen binnen het Microsoft-domein. Je krijgt veel ruimte om mee te denken over zowel de technische oplossing als de vraag erachter. Je bouwt dus niet alleen wat er gevraagd wordt: je denkt mee, stelt vragen en helpt onze organisatie steeds slimmer en digitaler te werken.

Amega is continu in ontwikkeling. Binnen onze verschillende bedrijven en afdelingen zien we veel mogelijkheden om processen slimmer te maken met software en automatisering. Als Full Stack Developer speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol.

Je werkt nauw samen met collega's vanuit de business. Dat kunnen bijvoorbeeld collega's zijn uit sales, aftersales, finance, marketing of onze ondersteunende afdelingen. Samen breng je een vraagstuk terug tot de kern en vertaal je dit naar een passende softwareoplossing.

Vervolgens ben je ook zelf betrokken bij de realisatie. Van database en back-end tot gebruikersinterface: jij vindt het juist leuk om over de volle breedte van een applicatie mee te denken en te ontwikkelen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

ontwikkelen en doorontwikkelen van interne applicaties en digitale oplossingen;
vertalen van wensen en processen uit de business naar concrete softwareoplossingen;
ontwikkelen van back-endfunctionaliteit met C# en .NET;
ontwikkelen van gebruiksvriendelijke webinterfaces;
bouwen en onderhouden van API's en integraties tussen verschillende systemen;
werken met databases, bijvoorbeeld Microsoft SQL Server;
meedenken over architectuur, kwaliteit, security en onderhoudbaarheid;
testen, reviewen en verbeteren van bestaande software;
signaleren van mogelijkheden om processen verder te automatiseren.

Je werkt daarbij niet vanaf een eiland. Juist het contact met gebruikers en collega's vinden we belangrijk. Soms begint je werk met een technisch vraagstuk, maar net zo vaak met een gesprek als: “We doen dit nu iedere dag handmatig, kan dat niet slimmer?” Daar krijg jij energie van.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij Amega krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de verdere professionalisering van onze softwareontwikkeling. Je werkt in een organisatie waar veel gebeurt en waar digitalisering volop in ontwikkeling is. Daarnaast bieden wij jou:

veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief: Zie jij een betere technische oplossing of een kans om iets slimmer te organiseren? Dan horen we dat graag.
direct contact met de business: Je ziet voor wie je software maakt en ervaart ook daadwerkelijk wat jouw oplossing oplevert.
veel afwisseling: Door de diversiteit binnen Amega kom je in aanraking met uiteenlopende processen, systemen en vraagstukken.
hybride werken: Je combineert werken vanuit onze locatie in Dordrecht met thuiswerken.
ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Ruimte om jezelf technisch én persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen door opleidingen, trainingen en praktijkervaring.
werken binnen het Microsoft-domein: Je werkt met technologie zoals .NET, C# en Microsoft SQL Server.
korte lijnen: Je werkt in een organisatie waarin je gemakkelijk kunt schakelen met collega's, management en andere afdelingen.
een marktconform salaris en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.
een informele werksfeer met enthousiaste collega's en een organisatie waarin samenwerken centraal staat.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

We zoeken geen developer die het liefst de hele dag met een koptelefoon op alleen tickets wegwerkt. Natuurlijk vinden we technische kennis belangrijk, maar minstens zo belangrijk vinden we jouw nieuwsgierigheid naar de organisatie achter de software.

Je wilt begrijpen hoe processen werken, waarom gebruikers bepaalde wensen hebben en hoe technologie hen écht verder kan c.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

HBO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld richting Informatica, Software Engineering of vergelijkbaar;
enkele jaren relevante ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar;
goede kennis van C# en .NET;
ervaring met webontwikkeling, zowel back-end als front-end;
ervaring met API's, integraties en databases;
ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server;
ervaring met Git en moderne ontwikkelprocessen;
je schrijft graag duidelijke, onderhoudbare en goed testbare software;
je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en denkt graag in oplossingen;
je communiceert gemakkelijk met zowel technische als niet-technische collega's;
je vindt het leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen van vraagstuk tot werkende oplossing.

Je hoeft niet ieder onderdeel van onze technische omgeving al volledig te beheersen. We vinden het belangrijker dat je een goede technische basis hebt, breed geïnteresseerd bent en graag nieuwe technologie en bedrijfsprocessen leert kennen.

Hier kom je te werken

Je komt te werken binnen de ICT-organisatie van Amega in Dordrecht. Amega is een grote en groeiende automotive dealerholding waarin verschillende bedrijven en disciplines samenwerken rondom mobiliteit.

Die diversiteit maakt jouw werk als developer juist interessant. Achter onze organisatie zitten allerlei processen rondom auto's, klanten, werkplaatsen, verkoop, mobiliteit, finance en dienstverlening. En overal liggen mogelijkheden om met slimme software het verschil te maken.

Binnen ICT werken we samen aan het ondersteunen én verder ontwikkelen van de organisatie. Daarbij willen we steeds meer zelf kunnen bouwen, automatiseren en integreren.

Als Full Stack Developer krijg jij de kans om daarin vanaf het begin mee te denken en zichtbaar bij te dragen.

Waarom deze functie bij Amega?

Omdat je hier niet alleen aan software werkt.

Je werkt aan oplossingen waarvan je vaak letterlijk een paar dagen later van een collega kunt horen wat ze hebben opgeleverd. Je krijgt de ruimte om de business in te gaan, vragen te stellen en samen iets nieuws neer te zetten.

Dus ben jij een Full Stack Developer die graag code combineert met nieuwsgierigheid naar mensen, processen en business?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Waarom kiezen voor Amega?

Werken met de gaafste automerken!
Sluit je aan bij een groeiend en succesvol bedrijf
Grootste automotive dealerholding in de regio
Financieel sterkste automotive bedrijf van Nederland
Professionele en positieve familiesfeer waardoor medewerkers gemiddeld 10,5 jaar bij ons blijven werken
8,5 medewerkers tevredenheid

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer(EN)
jobs.description:
Create your own future

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will help build digital solutions that support wealth planners in guiding clients through one of life's most important decisions: planning the transfer of wealth across generations.

ClientCenter is the central platform used by our commercial colleagues and is being extended with new capabilities that help wealth planners better understand client situations, streamline succession planning processes, and provide more personalised advice. Your work will directly contribute to improving how our colleagues support clients in achieving their long-term wealth goals.

This is a highly collaborative role where technology, business expertise and user needs come together. We believe the best products are built by teams that stay close to their users. That's why we're looking for someone who is curious, user-oriented and eager to understand both the business domain and the people who use the software every day.

Your responsibilities:

Design, build and maintain scalable applications and services
Develop end-to-end solutions using modern full stack technologies
Work closely with wealth planners to understand user workflows, validate assumptions and deliver solutions that create measurable value
Translate complex wealth and succession planning requirements into robust, secure and maintainable software
Develop a deep understanding of the Belgian wealth and succession planning domain and actively contribute to shaping digital solutions in this space
Collaborate with other development teams within the cluster to deliver seamless and integrated client journeys
Contribute to architecture decisions, technical design and the evolution of the platform
Leverage AI throughout the entire software development lifecycle while maintaining high standards for quality, security, and maintainability
Take ownership from analysis through implementation and release
Continuously improve development practices, testing approaches and system reliability
Coach and support junior team members through knowledge sharing, feedback and technical guidance

Your talents

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you combine strong technical expertise with curiosity for the business domain and the people who use the products you build. You take ownership, communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and are comfortable working in complex environments where business and technology intersect.

In addition, you have:

At least 5 years of experience as a Full Stack Developer
Strong experience with C# .NET, Angular, and modern web development technologies
Experience working with Azure-based solutions
A pragmatic approach to AI-assisted software development, balancing productivity gains with sound engineering judgement
Strong collaboration skills and experience working across multiple teams and stakeholders
A strong interest in understanding end-user workflows and improving the user experience
The ability to quickly understand complex functional domains and translate them into technical solutions
Excellent communication skills and experience working in Agile teams

Move ahead at Van Lanschot Kempen

Investing in a more future-oriented, sustainable, and data-driven way with various clients. Both nationally and internationally. With nearly 300 years of experience, we make this ambition a reality at Van Lanschot Kempen. We do this with more than 2,100 colleagues in various fields of expertise.

You will join a Scrum team that develops and evolves digital solutions supporting wealth and succession planning within the Private Clients domain. Working across the full stack, you will help create solutions that simplify complex processes and support colleagues in delivering high-quality advice to clients. You'll have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, contribute to product evolution and help establish best practices within the team.

An organisation's degree of innovation and agility also depends on the diversity of its workforce. Our differences make us stronger together. We promote an inclusive work environment where all colleagues feel at home. With us, you can be yourself. And we are proud of that.

Curious about the stories of colleagues and how they experience working at Van Lanschot Kempen? Go to Podcasts and find out more

That is what we do! The fact is, if you add value, you can expect the same from us in return. A good work-life balance with our ‘hybrid way of working’ is a good example of this. As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will also be given: 

a gross monthly salary between €5.500 and €7.000, depending on knowledge and experience
a flexible budget of 19.47% of your gross salary (including 13th month, 8% holiday pay, and 7 extra days off), to be spent on things like a bike, gym, or sabbatical
hybrid working with flexibility, with the team typically working from the Amsterdam office on Tuesdays and Thursdays
27 vacation days, including 7 within the flexible budget
a competitive pension scheme, with an average employer contribution of around 20%
the opportunity to work abroad for up to 2 months per year
a fully equipped home office setup, including an electric standing desk, ergonomic chair and monitors, delivered to your home
working from home allowance
an employee share plan, where Van Lanschot Kempen matches your investment in Van Lanschot Kempen shares up to €3,500 per year
Dutch and English language courses
extensive training opportunities and room for personal and professional development
weekly drinks at our bar in the office
discounted collective health insurance
chair massage and physio at the office

And many more employment benefits ready for you.  Discover all the benefits of working at Van Lanschot Kempen.

Excited about this opportunity? Apply through our website.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact Anna Skorobohata, Recruiter at a.skorobohata@vanlanschotkempen.com

En welke eisen stellen we, by design, aan de kwaliteit en veiligheid? Met de overgang naar de cloud en een zero trust architectuur ligt de lat hoog.

Jij werkt voor een of meer van onze DevOps-teams aan de architectuur van diverse applicaties die we zelf ontwikkelen, beheren en voortdurend vernieuwen. Denk aan toepassingen voor digitale rechtzaakdossiers, het uitwisselen van berichten of aan webportalen die externe partijen toegang geven tot onze informatie. Je zet het ontwerp in grote lijnen voor ze uit in een solution architectuur design en beantwoordt vragen bij de detailinvulling. Zo kunnen we agile werken aan een just-in-time architectuur.

Daarnaast werk je samen met ál onze architecten bij IVO Rechtspraak, dat geeft een extra dimensie aan je werk. Jullie zorgen voor samenhang binnen de totale architectuur van de Rechtspraak. jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
About Clockworks

Clockworks is a Rotterdam-based AI company. For more than ten years we have turned cameras, sensors and messy data streams into systems that read, look, count and predict, and then quietly do their job inside the operations of utilities, logistics and industrial companies.

A demo that works eighty percent of the time takes a week. We are in the business of the last twenty percent: the photo that is not quite sharp but still needs to be readable, off-hours peaks in traffic, a customer’s fifteen-year-old system everything has to plug into. We work in small teams with everything in-house to solve a problem end to end, with software and AI engineering in one room, which is why what we build actually goes live. Alongside client work we build our own products, such as Blicker, our meter-reading API for utility companies, and everything runs on ClockworksOS, our own toolkit for data, models and production systems.

The gears of a clock are complicated, and that is exactly why reading the time is simple. The same concept holds for the solutions we build and how we work.

The role

If the AI is the brain of a solution, our software engineers build the body around it. As Solution Architect you decide what that body looks like before a line of it is written, and then you help write it. You define how a vague AI idea becomes a system that meets real requirements for performance, scalability, security and maintainability, how it fits into whatever the client already has running, and you build the parts that matter most yourself.

You are one of two architects and you sit across everything we build: client projects, products such as Blicker, and ClockworksOS underneath them. You see architectural risk before anyone else does and say so, whether to a junior engineer, a client CTO or Clockworks leadership; when a project's technical direction is contested, you cut through the noise with a clear, defensible recommendation.

This is a coding architect role, not a slide-deck one. You combine everything a senior software engineer does, writing production code, reviewing pull requests, setting up infrastructure, with designing systems before implementation starts and reviewing all Clockworks solutions from an SE, DevOps and security perspective. At a team of our size there is no room for an architect who only draws boxes: the credibility of your designs comes from the fact that you can, and do, implement them.

What you'll work on

Build production code on the critical parts of our systems, from ClockworksOS platform components to the integration layer of a client project, so your architectural judgment stays grounded in what it takes to implement it.
Design scalable, secure and maintainable architectures for AI-integrated systems, from cloud to edge, and turn AI solution concepts into concrete implementation plans.
Review all Clockworks solutions, products and client projects alike, from an SE, DevOps and security lens, and raise architectural risk before a project hits trouble.
Define and govern our technical standards and architectural guidelines, documented in architectural decision records, and lead technical due diligence on complex engagements.
Build alignment around architectural decisions: bring engineers, clients and stakeholders along through clear, objective argumentation, keeping the end user and operational reality in view.
Mentor senior and medior engineers, and stay current on the full SE landscape, from cloud and security to the role of AI coding agents in how we build.

Who we're looking for

This is a senior role by definition: not the next step after senior engineer, but a distinct profile. You have:

8+ years of software engineering experience, including several years designing and owning the architecture of systems that run in production.
Deep, breadth-first knowledge of architecture patterns (microservices, event-driven, serverless), cloud-native architecture (Azure preferred), Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code such as Terraform or Pulumi, and the judgment to know which of these a specific problem actually needs.
A solid grasp of security architecture (zero-trust, data protection, GDPR, ideally ISO 27001) and of API design, integration patterns and data platform architecture, especially with systems that were never designed with AI in mind.
Strong programming skills in at least one modern language (most of our work is in Python) and the wish to keep using them: a substantial part of your week is building, and you want it that way.
The ability to explain complex trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, to hold your ground constructively when your view contradicts what a team has already committed to, and to know when to hold a standard and when to accept a compromise, with its cost made explicit.

It would be great if you also have experience architecting systems around machine learning or computer vision models (cloud and edge), with event streaming or high-volume data pipelines, with AI coding agents and an opinion on how they change the way teams build, or with working across several clients and codebases at a consultancy or agency. Fluent professional English is required; Dutch helps in client conversations.

Not ticking every box? If the hands-on part and the judgment are there, we would still like to hear from you.

Why us?

We offer:

A seat across everything Clockworks builds: client systems in utilities, logistics and industry, our own products, and the platform underneath them.
Architecture that has to hold up in the real world: computer vision on the edge, high-volume streams from cameras and sensors, and AI models running inside the operations of utilities and logistics companies. Nothing we build is a demo; everything goes live.
A small, senior team of engineers with backgrounds in AI, computer science and applied sciences, where software and AI engineering sit in one room and what we design actually goes live.
Responsibility that comes early and sits high: at a boutique like ours you are in the client conversations, the design decisions and the trade-offs from day one.
The latest language models and coding agents as part of how we work, from first analysis to code, and the freedom to shape how the team uses them.
A flat, informal company culture in the heart of Rotterdam, with competitive remuneration, flexible working conditions and a team that backs your professional ambitions.

Interested? Send us your CV and a short note on a system you designed that is still running, and why. Apply via our careers page or at careers@clockworks.co.

We hire directly. Agency submissions are not accepted.

Stel je voor: over een jaar kijkt een bestuurder naar een dashboard met actuele cijfers over onderwijs en onderzoek, en vertrouwt daar blindelings op. Niet omdat het toevallig klopt, maar omdat jij het datamodel eronder hebt gebouwd. Tien verschillende collega’s van decentrale teams werken dagelijks met data die via jouw platform beschikbaar, betrouwbaar en actueel is, zonder dat zij ooit stilstaan bij hoeveel werk daarachter zit.

Deze functie is nieuw: Hogeschool Rotterdam wil meer focus op data. Je bouwt een nieuw, onderliggend dataplatform waarmee de management rapportages en de decentrale ontwikkeling van ongeveer tien fte structureel en toekomstbestendig worden ondersteund.

Deze rol maakt onderdeel uit van de bredere digitaliseringsagenda van de hogeschool, waarin ook een vernieuwd IAM- en integratieplatform wordt gebouwd. Je speelt daarin een sleutelrol.
Dat maakt dit een kans om vanaf de fundamenten mee te bouwen aan een dataplatform, in plaats van in te stappen op iets dat al vaststaat.

Het team Data, Integratie en IAM groeit van drie naar maximaal acht teamleden. Je pakt zelf de inhoudelijke regie op dit vlak, met drie architecten als klankbord. Voor wie architectuurkeuzes het liefst zelf vormgeeft, is dit precies de ruimte die je zoekt.

Je bouwt mee aan een platform dat grotendeels nog moet worden neergezet, binnen kaders van portfolio en architectuur, maar met veel eigen ruimte voor keuzes.

In de eerste periode bepaal je samen met je team de vraag en behoefte en leg je deze vast in een roadmap. Vervolgens ga je aan de oplossing bouwen. Jij bent de data-expert, maar je werkt hierin nauw samen met je team.

Je vertaalt informatiebehoeften naar datamodellen en datastructuren, passend binnen organisatiebrede standaarden
Je ontwerpt en realiseert data pipelines en datasets voor rapportages, dashboards en analytics, en werkt toe naar vervanging van de huidige legacy-oplossing
Je past sectorstandaarden zoals OOAPI en organisatie-specifieke datamodellen toe en breidt ze uit
Je stemt af met de IAM- en Integratie-collega's binnen je team over autorisatie, datatoegankelijkheid en datakwaliteit
Je werkt samen met BI- en analytics-teams aan duurzame, goed gedocumenteerde data-oplossingen

Wat we jou bieden

Als Data Engineer bij Hogeschool Rotterdam werk je in Rotterdam aan een nieuw dataplatform voor onderwijs, onderzoek en bedrijfsvoering. Je krijgt een jaarcontract volgens de CAO HBO, met een dienstverband van 0,8 tot 1,0 fte en uitzicht op een vast dienstverband bij goed functioneren. Parttime is bespreekbaar.
€ 3.609 tot € 5.377 bruto per maand bij een fulltime dienstverband, schaal 10 CAO HBO
8% vakantiegeld en 8,3% eindejaarsuitkering
9 weken vakantie per jaar bij een fulltime dienstverband
Hybride werken, doorgaans twee tot drie dagen per week op locatie
Pensioen via ABP, fietsregeling, vergoedingen en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

45 duurzame inzetbaarheidsuren voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en werk-privebalans. Vakantiedagen kun je het hele jaar door flexibel inzetten en je bent niet gebonden aan de schoolvakanties. Je ontvangt vergoedingen voor internet, reizen en thuiswerken en hebt de mogelijkheid tot betaald ouderschapsverlof. Er is geen vast budget per medewerker, maar een teambrede pool voor scholing en ontwikkeling die wordt verdeeld op basis van functioneren en behoefte. Bij goede prestaties is er ruim budget beschikbaar om je verder te ontwikkelen. Bij een salariswens net boven de schaal kan een markttoelage worden toegepast, te bevestigen door Hogeschool Rotterdam.

Wat we van jou verwachten

Als Data Engineer bij Hogeschool Rotterdam in Rotterdam geef je zelfstandig richting aan de ontwikkeling van het dataplatform. Senioriteit is op dit moment doorslaggevend: we zoeken iemand die zelfstandig richting kan geven, niet alleen kan uitvoeren. Je brengt technische bagage mee en maakt complexe datavraagstukken helder voor business stakeholders.

Je hebt kennis van SQL en ervaring met datawarehousing, data lakes of moderne analyticsplatformen zoals Microsoft Fabric en OneLake

Je hebt programmeerervaring, bij voorkeur in C#/.NET, en ervaring met web-API's en formaten als JSON, YAML en XML
Je begrijpt data- en informatieanalyse, datakwaliteit, metadata en governance en hebt ervaring met werken in een agile/Scrum-omgeving

Data engineering is de kern van deze rol; C#/.NET-ervaring is gewenst, maar een sterk profiel op databronnen en datamodellering weegt het zwaarst. Je durft uit te spreken wat er anders, mooier of effectiever kan, en helpt het team daarmee groeien. Dat vinden we net zo belangrijk als je technische bagage.

Who we are supporting

The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.
The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:
Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.

Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.

At TOPIC, we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you the driven and ambitious Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
who enjoys writing production-quality code to automate testing of complex embedded systems that we are looking for?

“TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting-edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real-world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth."

Bohdan Dovbysh I Test Automation Engineer

What will you do as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)?

As an Software Development Engineer in Test, you operate at the intersection of software development and quality engineering. You design and build high-quality test infrastructure and automation in the same way developers build production systems. With your strong programming skills in C++and/or Python, you ensure software is testable, scalable, and reliable by design. You work closely with software engineers on complex high-tech systems, contributing directly to codebases, test architecture, and continuous integration pipelines. Rather than only validating software, you actively shape how it is built and verified.

Your responsibilities as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET):

Design, develop, and maintain test frameworks and automation tooling using C++ and/or Python
Contribute to production code and testability improvements in collaboration with software engineers
Develop automated tests across multiple levels (unit, integration, system) as part of the development process
Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines and test infrastructure to enable fast and reliable feedback
Analyze complex systems and failures, and trace issues to root cause in code
Drive testability, observability, and quality-by-design principles within development teams
Work on high-tech systems (embedded / hardware-software integration / distributed systems) with real-world impact
Take ownership of technical decisions around test architecture and tooling
Continuously improve automation strategy with a strong focus on engineering scalability and maintainability

What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

Challenging and interesting projects in different domains
Benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues
Focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions
Annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy
Tech events and knowledge sessions

Permanent contract
An all-in employment package between €57,000 and €76.000 (including net expense allowance, mobility package, 13th-month bonus, and holiday allowance). Final salary is based on relevant work experience and level of expertise
26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget (when you relocate to the Netherlands)

This will keep you healthy:

A good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working
An inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym
The home office support package will turn your “home office” into an inspiring environment
Lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks

What do you bring as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)?

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar
5 years of work experience in the high‑tech domain
Experience with programming in Python, C++ and/or C# and familiar with applying OO principles.
Hands‑on experience with test automation
Preferably experience with the ROBOT Framework and methodologies such as TDD, BDD, keyword‑driven testing, data‑driven testing, model‑based testing, and property‑based testing
You are a team player, solution-oriented, and proactive
A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language

Bij Intus Workforce Solutions helpen wij onze klanten en hun medewerkers met slimmer plannen. Hierdoor dragen we bij aan het oplossen van één van de belangrijkste maatschappelijke uitdagingen: personeelskrapte.
Onze innovatieve tech-oplossingen brengen flexibiliteit en efficiëntie in het planningsproces, en dat is fijn voor iedereen. Onze klanten kunnen onze medewerkers optimaal inzetten, terwijl we tegelijkertijd bijdragen aan meer werkgeluk en een gezonde werk-privé balans. Een win-win voor iedereen!

Wat ga je doen?

Als solution engineer realiseer je technische oplossingen van ontwerp tot oplevering. Deze technische oplossingen voorzien in een behoefte van een specifieke klant of groep klanten. Het kan bijvoorbeeld gaan om een complexe berekening uit een CAO over vakantierechten, het maken van een dashboard of een integratie met een ander systeem.

Je werkt het grootste deel van de tijd hands-on, zoals het analyseren van de klantvraag, het opstellen van een functioneel ontwerp en de oplossing coderen naar topklasse software. Ook het oplossen van bugs en het implementeren van nieuwe functies maakt deel uit van je dagelijkse routine.

We nemen je mee in ons InPlanning platform en alle features. Je bent voor klanten bezig en tegelijk ontwikkel je als engineer. Verder:
Je voelt je op je gemak in een scale-up omgeving en vindt het leuk om mee te werken in een snelgroeiend bedrijf
Je houdt ervan om verschillende complexe scenario's aan te pakken en je weg naar buiten te vinden. Je analyseert, probeert verschillende mogelijkheden uit en dan… coderen!

Wat breng jij mee?

Je hebt analytisch vermogen en een passie voor techniek.
Je beschikt over een afgeronde hbo/wo-opleiding in informatica of een vergelijkbare studierichting.
Je hebt ervaring met een object-georiënteerde programmeertaal (liefst Java). Als je ervaring hebt met Jmix, SQL, SQLMesh, RabbitMQ zou dat mooi van pas komen.
Je bent analytisch sterk en in staat om complexe software te doorgronden.
Je bent bij voorkeur bekend met nieuwe technologieën en vind je het leuk om die te kunnen toepassen.
Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een rol waarin jouw ideeën écht het verschil maken.
Werken met de nieuwste technologieën.
Een team van enthousiaste professionals.
Ruimte voor groei en ontwikkeling.

Verschillende ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden

;

te werken;

zodat je met de fiets naar kantoor kunt komen of tijdens de lunch of na kantoortijd een stukje kunt hardlopen!

jobs.description:
This is an opportunity to work with an Ashoka Staff

This is an unpaid, volunteer opportunity

About The Affiliated Organization

Founded in 1980, Ashoka pioneered the field of social entrepreneurship. We are now the largest association of leading social entrepreneurs in the world, a network of 4000+ Ashoka Fellows in 99 countries at work creating systemic change on the most pressing social and environmental issues of our time. We find, support and collaborate with our Fellows to help scale their solutions across nations and continents and work with a wide range of partners to create an "Everyone a Changemaker" world, one in which we all can find and develop our power to create meaningful change for the good of all.

For more information, please visit www.ashoka.org

Job Description

Ashoka is looking for senior-level professionals in Web Design, Development and Tech Support who can provide our Fellows with professional consults and project based support. We are creating an elite team of 10-15 members from different world regions (to reflect cultural contexts and language) in this field and in seven others of similarly high-value skillsets. We are calling these members Ashoka Professional Support Partners (PSPs) rather than "volunteers" to reflect the expertise and commitment to impact they will bring to our global community.

As an Ashoka Support Partner your expertise will be promoted to Fellows over the course of two to three months. If there is a need that meets your interests and availability, an introduction will be made so that you can learn more details about the support partnership and ways that you can contribute. Until that time your name and contact details will be held confidentially to protect your privacy.

As a Member Of The Web Design, Development And Tech Solutions Team You Will Be Working At The Intersection Of Digital Craft, Social-enterprise Literacy, And Capacity-building. Our Ashoka Fellows Are Leading Social Entrepreneurs Running Organizations That Often Need Stronger Digital Foundations To Scale Their Impact. A Senior Professional On This Team Would Help To Secure

Website security and vulnerability management
Backup and disaster recovery planning
Cloud platform management
AI-ready content architecture (good to have!)

Some of the CRM and Constituent systems fellows may need would be:

Salesforce
Microsoft Dynamics
HubSpot
Donor management systems
Constituent relationship managemen

Beyond the website itself, fellows would probably need support in the following technology areas:

Marketing Technology Stack ( Email marketing, campaigns, marketing automation etc)
Global reach (internationalization, localization, translation management, right to left language support)
Performance Engineering (Core Web Vitals, CDN strategies etc)
Mobile performance (this could actually be very crucial for fellows in emerging markets where most of their marketing will happen on Mobile platforms)
Platform Governance and Strategy (editorial permissions architecture, platform sustainability etc)

To summarize what is added above, it could help to have the following:

Experience with modern web architecture, security, performance optimization, AI-ready content systems, structured data, and advanced SEO/discoverability practices.
Demonstrated expertise in website security, accessibility, multilingual implementations, cloud hosting environments, and scalable content management architectures.
Build or rebuild Fellow and Fellow-led organizations' websites — from strategy and information architecture through design, development, and launch — so Fellows can credibly tell their story, recruit supporters, and raise funds online.
Design brand-aligned digital experiences — visual identity, UI/UX, landing pages, donation/fundraising flows, and campaign microsites that reflect each Fellow's mission and audience.
Modernize and maintain existing sites — auditing, migrating, and upgrading legacy platforms applying rigor to Fellows' sites.
Integrate essential nonprofit tooling — connecting sites to CRM/donor systems, email platforms, payment/donation processors, analytics, and multilingual/localization support for Fellows working across regions.
Coach and build Fellow capacity — transferring skills to Fellows and their teams so they can update content, run campaigns, and sustain their digital presence independently rather than depending on outside help indefinitely.

Please let us know today if you'd like to join this small but mighty team! You will be deeply appreciated and never taken for granted!

Volunteer Logistics

Estimated hours required per week: 5-10

The estimated duration of the project is: 1-3 months

This position is Virtual (Remote)

English, other Languages a big plus

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs.description:
A Funda QA Engineer doesn't simply slam buttons hoping that something will break. They don't go for idiot-proof, but instead work on improving the most important and intangible element of all, which is quality: meaning the quality of every line of code, every sprint and every release by the team. That makes a Funda QA Engineer the A in Team Awesome .

Your job in a nutshell

As a QA Engineer, you have a choice: you can either slow processes down or speed them up. Your preference speaks for itself. You enable the team to excel. One release per day or per week won't suffice; you go for continuous deployment whereby 10 releases a day become the norm.

Your responsibilities

Testing: conducting thorough testing to identify defects, bugs and issues
Test automation: using your knowledge of the code and domain, create automated tests to streamline testing process and make bug fixes and code changes
Quality assurance: ensuring that software products meet quality standards and specifications
Collaboration: working closely with developers, product managers and stakeholders and promoting a whole team approach to testing by sharing your knowledge

Read more in our Engineering blog post about why we ditched Selenium for Playwright (and how we nailed it)

The team

You will be an integral part of a multidisciplinary Scrum team, consisting of a Product Owner, UX Designer, and multiple Frontend and Backend Developers, and you will be part of the QA practise within Funda.

Why being a QA Engineer at Funda is awesome

We understand better than anyone that QA Engineers are a hot commodity. So why would you want to work at Funda? Apart from the fact that we are a top brand with large volume and traffic, and a riverfront office in Amsterdam (located on the IJ), your future colleague Jome (who broke her personal employment record here at Funda) captures it aptly: "You'd be working with some of the sharpest minds in the industry. It's both challenging and exciting.”

This is you

You have a wealth of experience in the field of Agile Testing within a Scrum environment. You have experience with test automation and programming (C#, Nuxt, Flutter), perhaps a result of your background as a developer. Additionally, you have experience with a Unit Testing framework (hopefully xunit), with designing, creating and maintaining automated tests (Playwright and integration tests in .NET Core) and with the use of version control systems (like Git and Github). You also have working knowledge of Azure DevOps and Kubernetes.

Next to that:
A bachelor's or other university degree in science
At least 5 years of relevant work experience
Knowledge of a Continuous Delivery software strategy
Experience working with an issue tracking system (e.g. Jira – check out our tech stack here)
A good command of the English language, both written and spoken.
You're currently living in the Netherlands

Read more in our Engineering blog post: Running Playwright tests in Azure DevOps: a step-by-step guide

Love being spoiled? Well, we love spoiling you!

A salary between €5323.26 - €6.295,58 per month, based on a 40 hours per week contract
Annual bonus of up to 1.5 times your monthly salary
Hybrid working
25 paid days off a year and the possibility to buy more
Working hours (32/36/40 per week) are negotiable
60% pension coverage
A learning budget of up to €2000 per year
A net monthly reimbursement of up to €85 for your phone and internet costs
A net work-from-home allowance of €2.45 per day
Full coverage of your travel costs for office days (if you live over 5 km away)
Unlimited access to mental support via OpenUp, including phone consultations with psychologists so you can blow off steam, get practical tips or just have someone to listen to you
The opportunity to take a 3-month (unpaid) sabbatical every 3 years
Contribution to your membership at selected gyms and regular massages at the office
Office lunch freshly prepared by our in-house chefs for a small, legally required contribution deducted from your salary
Regular parties, outings and a gift for your birthday – or just because, because why not?

Interested? Let's go!

Apply with your CV and motivation letter via the button below.
Meet one of our recruiters in a short video call.
Positive? Then you can expect a maximum of two interview rounds.
Before the first interview we will ask you to do an assignment.

Vue
React
Angular

Werde Teil unseres Teams

Als Backend-Entwickler .NET / C# (w/m/d) bei der SP Consult AG bist Du das Fundament unserer Software: Du entwickelst robuste, skalierbare und sichere Server-Anwendungen, Schnittstellen und Datenbanklösungen, die auch bei großen Events zuverlässig laufen. Bei uns erwarten Dich spannende technische Herausforderungen, ein starker Teamzusammenhalt und echte Verantwortung für das, was Du baust.

Du planst, entwickelst und implementierst eigenverantwortlich neue Backend-Module, Services und APIs für unsere Warenwirtschafts- und Ticketing-Lösung im Sport- und Freizeitbereich.

Du analysierst neue Kundenanforderungen und entwickelst daraus Lösungen mit echtem Mehrwert für das Gesamtsystem.
Du sicherst die Codequalität durch automatisierte Tests und Code Reviews.
Du arbeitest mit uns im Team nach dem Prinzip „You build it, you run it”

Das solltest Du mitbringen

Deine Hardware:

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium oder eine IT-Ausbildung absolviert, beispielsweise als Fachinformatiker (w/m/d) für Anwendungsentwicklung. Alternativ hast Du Dir Dein Know-how auf anderem Weg angeeignet und bringst langjährige praktische Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung mit. Für uns zählt, was Du kannst, nicht wie Du es gelernt hast.
Du hast nachweisbare Berufserfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit C# und .NET, idealerweise mit ASP.NET Core, und hast bereits an produktiv eingesetzter Software mitgearbeitet.
Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse relationaler Datenbanken (MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL oder vergleichbar) sowie idealerweise über Erfahrung mit ORM-Frameworks wie dem Entity Framework.
Nice-to-have: DevOps-Erfahrung, insbesondere mit Kubernetes (K8s), Docker und CI/CD-Pipelines, oder die Bereitschaft, Dich darin einzuarbeiten sowie Erfahrungen mit webbasierten Anwendungen auf Basis von Microsoft ASP.NET, JavaScript und Bootstrap.

Deine Software

Du analysierst komplexe Probleme strukturiert und entwickelst pragmatische, nachhaltige Lösungen.

Du hast Freude an Zusammenarbeit, Wissensaustausch und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

Du arbeitest selbstständig, bringst eigene Ideen ein und gestaltest Prozesse aktiv mit.
Sauberer, wartbarer Code ist für Dich selbstverständlich.

Du verständigst Dich sicher auf Deutsch, mindestens auf B2-Niveau. Gute Englischkenntnisse, vor allem im technischen Bereich, sind ein Plus.

Nicht alles passt perfekt? Kein Problem – wir setzen auf Einsatz, Leidenschaft und Teamfit statt auf starre Kriterien.

Das bieten wir Dir

Wir lieben Vielfalt. Wir arbeiten in einem offenen Arbeitsumfeld auf Augenhöhe. Diversität ist für uns gelebte Realität, genauso wie unsere Duz-Kultur.
Ein Team, das zusammenhält. Wir glauben an eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein Klima, in dem jede:r gehört wird.
Weiterbildung, die zu Dir passt. Bedarfsorientierte Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und regelmäßiger, konstruktiver Austausch gehören bei uns dazu.
Feelgood-Atmosphäre inklusive. Denn Dein Wohlbefinden ist uns wichtig. Frisches Obst und Getränke am Arbeitsplatz, sowie unser nagelneuer Team Space mit Fitnessgeräten, Billardtisch, Dartbereich und Fahrsimulator sollen dazu beitragen.
Mitarbeiter-E-Bike. Du hältst Dich auf dem Weg zur Arbeit fit und tust gleichzeitig der Umwelt was Gutes? Wir unterstützen Dich dabei mit einem E-Bike-Leasingangebot per Entgeltumwandlung.
Gemeinsame Erlebnisse. Ob Team-Events, Weihnachtsfeier, Sommerfest oder sportliche Aktivitäten - wir feiern Erfolge und Erlebnisse am liebsten gemeinsam.
Flexibles Arbeiten. Mobiles Arbeiten beziehungsweise Homeoffice ist bei uns nach Absprache möglich.
Weitere Benefits. Ein Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge sowie attraktive Corporate Benefits erwarten Dich.

Die SP Consult AG
ist ein erfahrenes IT-Unternehmen, das komplexe Web-Applikationen für Kunden im Profisport, Freizeitbereich und der Versicherungswirtschaft entwickelt und betreibt. Gemeinsam mit unserem Schwesterunternehmen LMS Sport
realisieren wir responsive Online-Shops für Event-Ticketing und Merchandising, die nahtlos in ERP-, CRM- und Warenwirtschafts-Backoffice-Lösungen integriert sind.

Als Teil der Manos Holding AG bildet die SP Consult AG gemeinsam mit unseren Schwestergesellschaften LMS Sport GmbH, Novantis Service GmbH und Reservix GmbH ein starkes Netzwerk am Standort Duisburg. Was uns verbindet? Die Leidenschaft für Service, Events, Sport und digitale Lösungen.

Die Unternehmen der Manos Holding AG sind mit rund 500 engagierten Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern an mehreren Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich vertreten. Darunter Berlin, Düsseldorf, Duisburg, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Leipzig, Oldenburg und Wien.

Für die SP Consult AG am Standort Duisburg suchen wir ab sofort Verstärkung.

CGI gehört zu den weltweit führenden Unternehmen für Business- und IT-Beratung. Mit über 94.000 Partnern arbeiten wir in lokal verankerten Teams und verbinden globale Expertise mit regionaler Nähe. Als Senior .NET Softwareentwickler für Microsoft Dynamics 365 arbeitest du an anspruchsvollen CRM- und xRM-Projekten. Dich erwarten moderne Architekturen, vielfältige Schnittstellen, hochwertige Lösungskonzepte und ein technikstarkes Team, das Wert auf Qualität, Weiterentwicklung und enge Zusammenarbeit legt.

Aufgaben

Entwicklung von Dynamics-365-Erweiterungen auf Basis von .NET / C#, einschließlich Plug-ins, Custom Workflows und Integrationen
Umsetzung von Schnittstellen zu ERP-, Portal- oder Drittsystemen (REST, SOAP, Webservices, Import/Export, API-Anbindungen)
Anpassung und Weiterentwicklung von Dynamics-365-Modulen und Geschäftsprozessen
Technische Analyse und Umsetzung von Anforderungen in enger Abstimmung mit Consultants, Architekt:innen und Fachbereichen
Durchführung von Tests, Code-Reviews und Dokumentation gemäß Entwicklungsrichtlinien
Unterstützung bei Deployments, ALM-Prozessen und DevOps-Pipelines
Einbringung neuer Technologien, Tools und Best Practices in die Entwicklungsarbeit

Qualifikation

Du bringst ein abgeschlossenes Studium im IT-Bereich oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit — entscheidend ist deine praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung.

Gute Kenntnisse in MS SQL Server, SQL-Programmierung und Datenmodellen
Erfahrung in der Schnittstellenentwicklung (REST, SOAP, Webservices, Integrationen)

Analytisches Denkvermögen, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und hohe Eigenverantwortung
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Kenntnisse in der Energie- und Versorgungswirtschaft

Außerdem beteiligen wir dich am Unternehmenserfolg: Du erhältst eine Gewinnbeteiligung, die sich nach deiner individuellen Leistung richtet, sowie danach, wie wir als Unternehmen unsere finanziellen Ziele erreichen konnten.
Mit Jobticket und Jobbike fördern wir umweltfreundliche Mobilität. Abhängig von deiner Rolle und Projektsituation sind auch Bahncard oder Elektro-Firmenwagen möglich.
Sabbatical oder Elternzeit werden unterstützt. Sie sind bei uns kein Karriere-Stopper!
Wir sind an deiner Seite, auch wenn es einmal nicht so gut läuft: Du kannst Sonderurlaub nehmen, und unsere Beratungshotline steht dir immer zur Verfügung.

About The Company

AgileGrid Solutions is a pioneering technology firm committed to delivering innovative software solutions that facilitate digital transformation across diverse industries. Our expertise lies in integrating advanced AI technologies and developing scalable backend architectures to meet the evolving needs of our clients. We prioritize quality, reliability, and future-proofing in all our offerings, ensuring our solutions support sustainable growth and operational excellence. Our company culture fosters collaboration, continuous learning, and a passion for technological innovation, creating an environment where talented professionals can thrive, grow their skills, and make a significant impact in the tech landscape.

About The Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Backend Developer with a strong passion for shaping AI-driven solutions and influencing technological strategies. In this role, you will go beyond routine maintenance and actively participate in designing and developing scalable backend systems. Your extensive experience will enable you to make critical decisions related to software architecture, API design, data modeling, and system integrations. A key aspect of this position involves leveraging modern AI coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar agents to enhance productivity, code quality, and development efficiency. You will be responsible for creating innovative AI-supported applications, integrating external systems, and collaborating closely with product managers, domain experts, and fellow developers to transform technological possibilities into practical, deployable solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to embed AI coding tools into daily workflows, enabling faster, more secure, and high-quality software delivery while maintaining rigorous standards of security and maintainability.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have between 7 to 10 years of professional experience in backend development, demonstrating a solid understanding of software architecture, API design, database management, and automated testing. Proven expertise in at least one backend technology such as Python, Java, C#, TypeScript, or Node.js is essential. Candidates should possess a thorough knowledge of version control systems like Git and CI/CD workflows. Experience working with AI coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, or GitHub Copilot, including prompt engineering, context management, and quality assurance of AI-generated code, is highly desirable. Strong ownership mentality, excellent collaboration skills, and the ability to transfer knowledge effectively are crucial. Proficiency in German is required, along with good English skills, to facilitate seamless communication within our diverse team environment.

Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include designing and implementing complex backend solutions from initial concept through to deployment in production environments. You will take ownership of software architecture, define API specifications, data models, and ensure seamless system integrations. A significant aspect of your role involves utilizing AI coding tools effectively for implementation, refactoring, testing, and troubleshooting tasks. You will critically evaluate AI-generated code for quality, security, and maintainability, ensuring compliance with industry standards. Collaboration with product teams, domain experts, and fellow developers is essential to develop AI-enabled applications and services, including integrating large language model (LLM) APIs and external systems. You will contribute to establishing and maintaining best practices, development standards, and technological innovations within the team. Your expertise will influence the future of AI-driven backend development and directly impact project success and organizational growth.

Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including a €600 health budget for massages, glasses, and other health-related expenses. Our top-tier health insurance coverage extends to you and your family, providing peace of mind. Additional perks include fitness bonuses, quick access to medical specialists, and a digital health coach to support your well-being. We promote flexible work arrangements with options for remote work and provide 30 days of vacation to ensure work-life balance. Job security is guaranteed through permanent employment contracts. Employees have access to ongoing training and development programs to enhance their skills. Our modern green office spaces foster a productive work environment, complemented by team events, discounts, parking facilities, fresh fruit, beverages, and online shopping discounts. We also offer company car options for professional and private use, environmentally friendly mobility solutions such as JobRad leasing, and access to fitness and health services via EGYM Wellpass. Additional programs include JobCar, sustainable E-Car leasing, and affordable hardware leasing through MeinMPP.

Equal Opportunity

AgileGrid Solutions is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We believe that diverse perspectives and backgrounds are essential for innovation and excellence. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, or background. Our hiring process is transparent and fair, and we are committed to providing equal opportunities for growth and development to all employees. Join us in becoming part of a forward-thinking organization that values diversity, equity, and inclusion at every level of our work culture.

Dabei entwickeln wir uns persönlich immer weiter und unterstützen uns gegenseitig auf diesem Weg. Weil für uns gilt: Besser gemeinsam weiterkommen.

Aufgaben, durch die Sie weiterkommen

Als Trainee SAP Integration & AI Engineer (m/w/d) sind Sie im Geschäftsbereich Digitalisierung, Prozesse und IT tätig.

Ihre Aufgaben:

Sie wirken maßgeblich an der technischen Integration unserer SAP-Systemlandschaft mit modernen Cloud-, Automatisierungs- und KI-Plattformen mit. Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Entwicklung, Erweiterung und Anbindung von SAP-Schnittstellen, insbesondere auf Basis von OData- und REST-Services.
Sie entwickeln Integrationslösungen zwischen SAP S/4HANA sowie modernen Cloud-Plattformen wie Microsoft Azure. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Fachbereichen analysieren Sie Integrationsanforderungen, implementieren Schnittstellen und unterstützen bei der technischen Weiterentwicklung unserer Integrationsarchitektur.
Auf dieser Grundlage arbeiten Sie zudem an innovativen KI-Anwendungsfällen. Sie entwickeln und integrieren AI Use Cases, die Geschäftsprozesse intelligenter und effizienter gestalten. Hierzu gehören beispielsweise die Anbindung von Large Language Models (LLMs), die Entwicklung von AI-Assistenten sowie von KI-Komponenten innerhalb bestehender Unternehmensprozesse.
Darüber hinaus unterstützen Sie bei der Entwicklung moderner APIs, cloudbasierter Anwendungen und Automatisierungslösungen. Sie arbeiten mit aktuellen Technologien aus den Bereichen SAP, Cloud Computing, Künstliche Intelligenz und Enterprise Integration und erhalten die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung für eigene Projekte zu übernehmen.

Fähigkeiten, die Sie einbringen

Sie haben ein Hochschulstudium in einer der folgenden Studienrichtungen erfolgreich abgeschlossen: (Wirtschafts-) Informatik, (Wirtschafts-) Mathematik, Data Science, Künstliche Intelligenz oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang.
Sie haben Spaß an analytischem Arbeiten und bringen die Neugier mit, sich mit neuen Technologien zu beschäftigen und diese zum Einsatz zu bringen.
Sie interessieren für die Integration von SAP-Systemen mit modernen Technologien, sind bereit, sich in neue Themengebiete einzuarbeiten.
Sie sind versiert im Umgang mit MS Office und verfügen idealerweise über erste Erfahrungen im SAP-Umfeld und haben bereits mit OData-Schnittstellen, SAP Gateway, SAP BTP oder der Anbindung von SAP-Systemen über APIs gearbeitet.
Darüber hinaus besitzen Sie erste Kenntnisse in der Softwareentwicklung, insbesondere mit Python, SQL, C+++ oder ABAP.
Sie haben fließende mündliche und schriftliche Kenntnisse in der deutschen Sprache (mind. C1 Niveau).

Vorteile, die Ihren Alltag besser machen

Wir bieten Ihnen ein inhaltlich vielfältiges Traineeprogramm mit persönlicher Betreuung, Hospitationen in verschiedenen Unternehmenseinheiten, gezielten Personalentwicklungsmaßnahmen sowie regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen zur eigenen Standortbestimmung.
Bei uns erwartet Sie eine zukunftssichere Tätigkeit bei einem bedeutenden Arbeitgeber im Gesundheitswesen, der Ihnen die Sicherheit des öffentlichen Dienstes bietet.
Wir bieten Ihnen viel Gestaltungsfreiraum bei Ihrer täglichen Arbeit.
Als zertifiziertes Unternehmen steht bei uns die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie im Fokus. Diese bieten wir Ihnen z.B. mit einer flexiblen wöchentlichen Arbeitszeit, passend zu Ihrer Work-Life-Balance.
Sie erhalten bei uns eine attraktive Einstiegsvergütung nach Vergütungsgruppe 9 BAT/AOK-Neu bei entsprechender Qualifikation (mindestens 60.796,- EUR/jhrl. inkl. Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld). Zusätzlich zahlen wir Sozialzuschläge, wenn Sie verheiratet sind oder Kinder haben.
Neben einer attraktiven tariflichen Vergütung erhalten Sie bei uns verschiedene weitere Arbeitgeberleistungen wie eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge, vermögenswirksame Leistungen und diverse weitere Corporate Benefits.
Gegenseitige Wertschätzung, eine offene und respektvolle Kommunikation sowie eine vertrauenswürdige Führungs- und Fehlerkultur – diese Unternehmenswerte, die sich auch in unserem Unternehmensleitbild wiederfinden, sind uns sehr wichtig.

Eine umfassende Übersicht unserer Mitarbeitenden-Vorteile finden Sie hier.

Und jetzt?

Jobbeschreibung

Standort Görlitz | Vollzeit | Festanstellung

Wir suchen einen Mitarbeiter, der nicht nur vorhandene Testskripte pflegen, sondern die technische Richtung in der Testautomatisierung mitgestalten möchte.

Bei SIEVON bekommst du den Freiraum, technische Lösungen aktiv mitzugestalten. Als Senior Testautomatisierer (m/w/d) entwickelst du Automatisierungsstrategien und Frameworks, die nicht nur heute funktionieren, sondern auch langfristig wartbar und erweiterbar bleiben. Dabei kombinierst du technisches Know-How mit strategischem Denken, berätst unsere deutschsprachigen Kunden und bringst deine Erfahrung in unser Team ein. Du übernimmst Verantwortung, hinterfragst bestehende Ansätze und hilfst anderen dabei, fachlich zu wachsen. Wir glauben an direkte Zusammenarbeit, kurze Entscheidungswege und echten persönlichen Austausch. Deshalb ist Görlitz unser gemeinsamer Arbeitsort. Mobiles Arbeiten ist ergänzend möglich, eine vollständig remote ausgeübte Tätigkeit bieten wir für diese Position nicht an.

Deine Aufgaben

Du konzipierst Testautomatisierungsstrategien und setzt sie gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden und Projektteams um
Du entwickelst und optimierst Frameworks für Frontend-, API- und Regressionstests
Du integrierst automatisierte Tests und Quality Gates in CI/CD-Pipelines
Du triffst technische Entscheidungen zu Architektur, Werkzeugen, Wartbarkeit und Ausführungsstrategien
Du analysierst instabile Tests, technische Abweichungen und Qualitätsrisiken und leitest konkrete Verbesserungen ab
Du führst Code- und Konzeptreviews durch und vermittelst Best Practices im Team
Du moderierst technische Abstimmungen und Workshops mit deutschsprachigen Kunden
Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und bei der Weiterentwicklung von QA- und Automatisierungsteams

Was dich bei SIEVON erwartet

Technischer Gestaltungsspielraum statt reiner Ticketbearbeitung
Direkter Einfluss auf Automatisierungsstrategien und Qualitätsstandards
Anspruchsvolle Projekte bei namhaften Kunden
Ein erfahrenes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
Gezielte fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung
Moderne Arbeitsausstattung
Mehr als 30 Urlaubstage bei Vollzeit
Unterstützung bei der Absicherung im Alter
Angebote für deine Gesundheit und Fitness im Arbeitsalltag
Ein Arbeitsplatz im Herzen von Görlitz

Das bringst du mit

Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im Softwaretest, davon mehrere Jahre in der praktischen Testautomatisierung
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in mindestens einer relevanten Programmiersprache, beispielsweise Java, TypeScript/JavaScript oder C#
Praxiserfahrung mit mindestens einem etablierten Automatisierungsframework, beispielsweise Playwright, Selenium, Cypress oder REST Assured
Erfahrung mit Frontend- und API-Automatisierung sowie mit Git und CI/CD
Ein gutes Verständnis für Testarchitektur, wartbaren Code, Testpyramiden und risikobasierte Automatisierung
Die Fähigkeit, technische Entscheidungen verständlich zu erklären und Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung zu übernehmen
Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf Niveau C1, da Kundenkommunikation, Workshops und Projektdokumentation überwiegend auf Deutsch stattfinden
Die Bereitschaft, regelmäßig an unserem Standort in Görlitz zu arbeiten
Eine gültige Arbeitsberechtigung für Deutschland spätestens zum Eintritt

Das ist ein Plus

Erfahrung mit Docker, Kubernetes oder cloudbasierten Testumgebungen
Kenntnisse im Performance-, Security- oder Mobile-Testing
Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der fachlichen Führung eines QA-Teams
Eine ISTQB-Zertifizierung
Erfahrung in Beratungs- oder Kundenprojekten

Du erfüllst nicht jeden einzelnen Punkt? Wenn du Testautomatisierung technisch beherrschst, Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und zu unserem Arbeitsmodell passt, sollten wir trotzdem miteinander sprechen.

Über uns

SIEVON ist ein etabliertes IT-Beratungsunternehmen aus Görlitz. Unsere Wurzeln liegen in der Softwarequalität, daher unterstützen wir heute Unternehmen in den Bereichen Qualitätssicherung, Testautomatisierung, Softwareentwicklung und der agilen Zusammenarbeit. Softwarequalität entsteht für uns durch klare Ziele, durchdachte Prozesse, passende technische Lösungen und Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen. Deshalb verbinden wir methodische Beratung mit praktischer Umsetzung und begleiten unsere Kunden von der ersten Anforderung bis zur funktionierenden Software. Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, direkt und auf Augenhöhe. Statt unnötiger Bürokratie setzen wir auf nachvollziehbare Entscheidungen und Lösungen, die sich im Projektalltag bewähren. Dabei hinterfragen wir bestehende Ansätze, teilen unser Wissen und entwickeln uns gemeinsam weiter. SIEVON steht für fachlichen Anspruch, verlässliche Zusammenarbeit und ein Team, in dem unterschiedliche Erfahrungen und Stärken zusammenkommen. Unser Standort in Görlitz ist dabei mehr als eine Adresse: Hier arbeiten wir gemeinsam, tauschen uns persönlich aus und entwickeln unser Unternehmen Schritt für Schritt weiter.

jobs.title: Engineering Compliance and CSV Manager
jobs.description:
Hi! We are AMBOSS, and we're looking for someone to take the role of Engineering Compliance Manager and CSV & Process Validation Manager
in our medical device team.

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering physicians globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Why can this position be exciting for you?

At AMBOSS, we build tools that help doctors and students make critical decisions impacting the healthcare of billions of people worldwide. This position makes sure that our product is built, verified, and documented in a way that's compliant, trustworthy, and audit-ready. You'll work closely with engineering as an independent evaluator, setting the standard for what "done and compliant" means across our medical device software. Join a small, high-impact team ensuring our medical device software meets the regulatory standards needed to safely support healthcare professionals.

You Will

As CSV & Process Validation Manager, prove our systems and processes work and produce reliable evidence.

Own the computer system validation and process validation processes for the AMBOSS medical device portfolio — procedures, templates and work instructions — keeping them aligned with MDR and ISO 13485 and updated based on audit findings and team feedback.
Maintain the inventory of systems in scope and decide, risk-based, which need validation and to what depth; plan, execute and document that validation and keep systems in a validated state as they change.
Concentrate validation effort where the evidence is produced — test management, defect tracking, build/release tooling and automated pipeline steps whose output can't be fully verified by inspection alone — confirming these systems and processes reliably produce trustworthy, intended results.
Own the resulting evidence and represent it directly to auditors and regulators; raise, document and own validation deviations and the associated CAPAs through to resolution.

As Engineering Compliance Manager, ensure the medical device product itself is built compliantly, from a day-to-day engineering work perspective

Own compliant execution of the software lifecycle — requirements, design, implementation, verification, release — against IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1
Define the compliance requirements and gates in our delivery pipeline against IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1 (traceability tagging, release criteria, automated checks) and partner with engineering to implement them.
Operate the compliance gate in the release flow, keeping the trace intact from user requirement through verification to released evidence. Sign off each release as a required gate; no release ships without your approval.
Ensure engineering-related Technical Documentation deliverables are compliant with regulatory and QMS requirements
Onboard and train software engineers on compliance requirements and how to work within them day-to-day.
Act as the point of contact for audits and technical reviews on engineering-related topics, representing the team's compliance posture to auditors and Notified Body reviewers.
Drive resolution of audit findings and deficiencies affecting engineering.
Assess the engineering impact of Design Changes before they are implemented.
Identify and drive adoption of tooling the team is missing to work compliantly — both inside the QMS and on the engineering side.

You Bring

Knowledge of medical devices or another regulated industry (pharma, biotech, IVD). Experience in, or eagerness to learn, computer system validation and/or process validation, including risk-based scoping of validation effort, is a plus.
Working knowledge of MDR, ISO 13485, IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1 as they apply to software.
Familiarity with software engineering, and enough depth in our stack (React, Python, PHP, Go; AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, ArgoCD) to review pipelines, tests and release processes with engineers as a peer.
Experience representing validation documentation and rationale to auditors and inspectors.
Experience assessing the engineering/technical impact of Design Changes within a regulated development process.
Excellent written and spoken English

You Enjoy

Working closely with engineers, Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs — able to challenge and be challenged on technical detail.
Strong communication and training skills, with the ability to explain complex validation requirements to cross-functional stakeholders
Structured, detail-oriented way of working, with the ability to balance regulatory rigor with practical, workable processes for development teams

Benefits

AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized, and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health and work-life harmony.

Check out all of our employee benefits here: https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. That's why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone — regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity — is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfill our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care.

Even if you don't meet every single point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We'd love to hear from you!
