jobs.description:
Technology is our how. And people are our why. For over two decades, we have been harnessing technology to drive meaningful change.

By combining world-class engineering, industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we consult and partner with leading brands from various industries to create dynamic platforms and intelligent digital experiences that drive innovation and transform businesses.

From prototype to real-world impact - be part of a global shift by doing work that matters.

Job Description

As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

In this role, you will work within a cross-functional product team responsible for modernising the user experience, backend services and cloud platform capabilities of one of WTW’s strategic cloud platforms.

You will contribute to a business-critical distributed compute platform that executes large-scale insurance modelling workloads across the organisation. The platform dynamically provisions Azure compute resources, runs computationally intensive jobs submitted by multiple business applications and provides a shared cloud foundation for analytical services.

The role combines frontend and backend development, cloud-native engineering and modern software engineering practices. You’ll help replace legacy technologies, rebuild AngularJS portals, modernise backend services, introduce Infrastructure as Code, migrate workloads to Azure Container Apps and improve deployment automation and operational resilience.

Working alongside experienced platform engineers, architects, product owners, DevOps engineers and QA specialists, you’ll help transform the current platform into a modern Azure-native platform while gaining deep knowledge of cloud platform engineering and distributed systems.

What Success Looks Like

In this role you will:

Contribute to meaningful modernisation outcomes across the platform and related services.
Deliver high-quality frontend and backend changes that are secure, maintainable and easy to operate.
Improve platform reliability, scalability and performance through well-tested engineering changes.
Apply agreed engineering standards, coding practices and review feedback consistently.
Support faster, more predictable delivery by contributing to automation, CI/CD and DevOps improvements.
Collaborate effectively with architects, product owners, QA, DevOps and other engineers to solve delivery challenges.
Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture.

Key Responsibilities

Application Development

Develop modern Angular applications replacing legacy AngularJS user and administration portals.
Design, develop and maintain .NET backend services supporting distributed compute workloads.
Build and enhance REST APIs consumed by multiple business applications.
Modernise legacy platform functionality while preserving business continuity.
Implement scalable, maintainable and secure software following modern engineering practices.

Platform Modernization

Participate in migration towards Azure Container Apps and containerised workloads.
Support Infrastructure as Code implementation using OpenTofu/Terraform.
Contribute to cloud-native platform modernization initiatives.
Participate in modernisation of deployment pipelines and release automation.
Help improve platform scalability, maintainability and operational resilience.

Engineering Excellence

Write unit, integration and automated tests ensuring software quality and reliability.
Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.
Apply Clean Code principles, modern software design patterns and engineering best practices.
Support continuous integration and continuous delivery initiatives.
Contribute to zero-downtime deployment improvements.

Operations & Collaboration

Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Architects, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers and fellow Software Engineers.
Participate in production support and on-call rotation as part of the engineering team.
Contribute to troubleshooting, root cause analysis and continuous platform improvements.
Share knowledge and actively participate in building the engineering capability.

Qualifications

Software Engineering

4–6 years of commercial software development experience.
Strong experience with C#, modern .NET and ASP.NET.
Strong experience with Angular and TypeScript.
Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs.
Good understanding of object-oriented programming and modern software engineering principles.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Experience developing applications on Microsoft Azure.
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience working with Docker and containerised applications.
Understanding of Infrastructure as Code principles, with the ability and willingness to work with tools such as OpenTofu or Terraform.
Understanding of cloud-native application development principles.

Engineering Practices

Experience writing unit and integration tests.
Understanding of Clean Code principles and software design patterns.
Experience working in Agile Scrum teams.
Ability to work within a collaborative cross-functional engineering team.

Soft Skills

Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Proactive approach to problem solving.
Willingness to learn modern cloud platform technologies.
Passion for continuous improvement and engineering excellence.

Preferred Skills and Experience

Azure Container Apps
Azure Batch
OpenTofu or Terraform
Playwright
SQL Server
Redis
SignalR
Experience working on cloud-native platforms
Experience modernising legacy enterprise applications

Our benefits offering typically include private medical insurance, dental plan, and glasses reimbursement. All remuneration and benefits decisions are based on non-discriminatory, gender-neutral criteria, and in accordance with the Polish Labour Code amendments implementing Directive on pay transparency, we do not request or consider candidates’ current or past remuneration during the recruitment process.”

At Endava, we harness technology to drive meaningful change. By combining AI-native engineering, deep industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we partner with leading organisations to solve complex business challenges and create digital products and platforms that make a lasting impact.

From strategy and design to engineering and operations, we help our customers accelerate innovation and transform their businesses. Join us and be part of a global team delivering work that matters.

Job Description

As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you will join an experienced cross-functional engineering team responsible for designing, developing and evolving the Authentication and Authorization capability used across multiple products and engineering teams.

This is not a traditional application development role. Instead, you will help build a reusable identity platform that enables other engineering teams to adopt standardised authentication and authorisation services while improving security, developer experience and operational efficiency.

The capability provides shared identity and access management services that help applications authenticate users securely, authorise access to business resources and integrate with enterprise identity providers.

Built on Auth0, Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) and modern Azure services, it includes reusable SDKs, reverse proxy services and developer tooling that make secure integration simpler across ICT’s technology landscape.

You will work closely with architects, product teams, platform engineers and business stakeholders helping deliver secure, scalable and high-quality technology solutions that create value for WTW and its customers. You will be expected to work with a high degree of autonomy, take ownership of significant work packages and make sound technical decisions within the agreed platform direction.

Develop reusable platform services supporting secure authentication and authorization across multiple business applications.
Build scalable REST APIs and integration services used throughout the organisation.
Develop and maintain Angular-based administration portals supporting user, group and permission management.
Contribute to the evolution of Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) capabilities and centralized access management services.

jobs.description:
Technology is our how. And people are our why.

At Endava, we harness technology to drive meaningful change. By combining AI-native engineering, deep industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we partner with leading organisations to solve complex business challenges and create digital products and platforms that make a lasting impact.

From strategy and design to engineering and operations, we help our customers accelerate innovation and transform their businesses. Join us and be part of a global team delivering work that matters.

Job Description

As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will join an experienced cross-functional engineering team responsible for designing, developing and evolving the Authentication and Authorization capability used across multiple products and engineering teams.

This is not a traditional application development role. Instead, you will help build a reusable identity platform that enables other engineering teams to adopt standardised authentication and authorisation services while improving security, developer experience and operational efficiency.

The capability provides shared identity and access management services that help applications authenticate users securely, authorise access to business resources and integrate with enterprise identity providers.

Built on Auth0, Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) and modern Azure services, it includes reusable SDKs, reverse proxy services and developer tooling that make secure integration simpler across ICT’s technology landscape.

You will work closely with architects, product teams, platform engineers and business stakeholders helping deliver secure, scalable and high-quality technology solutions that create value for WTW and its customers.

Support platform adoption by improving SDKs, documentation, developer tooling and integration patterns.
Contribute to automation, CI/CD and cloud platform improvements that make delivery faster and more predictable.
Collaborate with architects, product owners, QA, DevOps and consuming product teams to solve identity and access management challenges.
Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture within the Quartz team.

Build scalable REST APIs and integration services used throughout the organisation.

Contribute to the evolution of Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) capabilities and centralized access management services.

Build developer tooling that improves onboarding and adoption of shared authentication services.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation using Azure DevOps.

We are building the foundational infrastructure and platform services that power the next generation of Sectra's medical imaging and healthcare solutions. You will design and deliver production-grade platform services and infrastructure while leveraging modern AI tools and techniques to accelerate development and enhance system capabilities. Your work ensures that whether it's logging, edge computing, monitoring, or performance optimization, our platform services are rock-solid, efficient, and enable seamless integration across the entire Sectra ecosystem.

What You Will Do

Design, build, and maintain high-quality platform services and infrastructure used across all Sectra product areas
Apply AI tools (e.g., code assistants, code generators) responsibly to increase velocity without compromising quality, security, or cost
Collaborate with product teams, architects, and end-users to translate infrastructure requirements into robust, scalable solutions
Own features end-to-end: design, implementation, testing, observability, documentation, and deployment
Implement and uphold strong engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, performance profiling, reliability standards
Work with modern distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and observability patterns (metrics, logging, tracing, SRE practices)
Administer and optimize Linux-based infrastructure, including system configuration, performance tuning, scripting and troubleshooting
Continuously learn: evaluate new tools, frameworks, and AI capabilities; share knowledge across the team and the broader organization

Core abilities:

Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures/algorithms, concurrency, networking, API design, distributed systems, software architecture
Strong Linux systems expertise: command-line proficency, shell scripting (Bash), system administration, networking, process management, and troubleshooting in production environments
Proficiency in one or more languages used for high-performance backend and infrastructure development (e.g., C#, Typescript, C++, Go) and modern tooling
Experience with cloud services, containers, and CI/CD (AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, or serverless)
Reliability and observability mindset: automated testing, monitoring (metrics/logs/traces), performance awareness, and SRE practices
Security and privacy literacy (secure coding, handling sensitive data, infrastructure security)
Curiosity and learning agility; ability to adapt to new domains, tools, and AI workflows
Excellent communication skills and a collaborative, cross-functional approach
Required: Humor and strong academic record from university and upper secondary school; please include transcripts or grade summaries in your application

Familiarity with healthcare IT standards and constraints (compliance, data handling, interoperability)
Frontend experience that complements backend work, or infrastructure tooling/dashboards
Pursue passions outside of work, whether in sports, music, the arts, or unique hobbies

,

We always look for your willingness and ability to learn and take on new tasks fast, utilize previous experiences and quickly grasp new information. We also want you to have a strong analytical mindset, since we consider your ability to understand, break down and solve problems very important. We also look for good communicators who have the ability to interact with colleagues, partners and customers in an effective, clear and constructive way.

Why this role is more than a job

Your work will have a direct impact on every product team at Sectra and the clinicians and patients they serve. By building reliable, performant, and secure platform services, you enable our healthcare solutions to scale, adapt, and ultimately improve diagnostics and care. If you're motivated by the responsibility of building the backbone that others depend on, and you believe that great engineering done with care and precision matters, you'll feel at home here.

Time and budget for learning and professional development
An engineering culture that values quality, reliability, security, and impact

This is how we create conditions for a healthier and safer society.

jobs.title: Data & AI Solution Architect

Vilka är vi?

På Dyve hjälper vi ambitiösa organisationer att omsätta strategier och idéer inom verksamhet och teknik till lösningar som fungerar i praktiken.
Dyve finns i Stockholm och Örnsköldsvik. Nu rekryterar vi till vårt kontor i Örnsköldsvik, där vi bygger ett team som förenar verksamhetsförståelse med arkitektur, data, AI och tekniskt genomförande. Hos oss får du arbeta nära kunderna, ta stort ansvar och vara med och forma hur vi växer.
Vi arbetar nyfiket och prestigelöst, med stark tilltro till vad vi kan åstadkomma tillsammans.

Vem är du?

Du kombinerar arkitektens helhetsperspektiv med en stark förmåga att omsätta idéer till fungerande lösningar.
Du kan förstå en verksamhets utmaningar, utforma en hållbar teknisk lösning och bidra aktivt till att ta den från idé till verklighet. Du trivs med att röra dig mellan kunddialoger, arkitekturfrågor och praktiskt genomförande.
Du kan förklara tekniska vägval för olika målgrupper och tycker om att samarbeta med andra för att skapa resultat som håller över tid.

Vad tar du med dig?

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av att utforma lösningsarkitektur och utveckla moderna data- och AI-lösningar. Du behöver inte ha haft titeln Data & AI Solution Architect tidigare, men du drivs av att kombinera teknik, verksamhetsförståelse och praktiskt genomförande.
Vi ser gärna att du har flera av följande erfarenheter:
Utformning av lösningsarkitektur, dataarkitektur eller molnarkitektur
Utveckling av AI-lösningar och intelligenta applikationer
Integration av AI-lösningar med befintliga system, data och arbetsflöden
Att ta tekniska lösningar från idé och prototyp till användning i verksamheten

Att samarbeta nära kunder och team med olika kompetenser

jobs.title: Principal Enterprise Architect
jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Role:

We are looking for a curious, smart, and “learn it all” Architect with proven experience and a passion for designing transformative solution architectures for our prospects and customers. This high-impact role demands a unique blend of deep technical expertise and executive presence, requiring you to confidently present to C-level executives
and translate their strategic goals into actionable technical plans. You will work with technical teams at our prospects and customers to design architectures that drive enterprise modernization
, leveraging techniques like capability mapping
and exploring innovative solutions with Agentic AI
.

Your primary goal is to support our growing sales team in achieving revenue goals by unlocking technical blockers and partnering closely with our Sales, Value Engineering, Product Management, Data Ops, and Information Security teams. You will be responsible for supporting engagements with new prospects as well as existing customers that look to expand their footprint. Measures of success include new customer acquisition rates, retention, up-selling, and contribution to overall sales team and business success.

The work you’ll do:

Lead and define the overall architecture, data, and cloud strategy for our largest client accounts, leveraging expertise like enterprise modernization and capability mapping.
Confidently engage with and present to customer C-level executives, aligning their strategic objectives with the Celonis technical strategy.
Drive innovation by identifying and architecting solutions that leverage emergent technologies, including Agentic AI.
Be the bridge between our product & engineering teams within Celonis and the client's teams to provide the best technical services.
Assess the IT landscape maturity of our customer installed base for the region.
Participate in pre-Sales and post-Sales phases by engaging with customer Architecture and security teams.
Coach and guide Celonis consulting teams and ecosystem partners on technical implementation issues such as architecture, integration, performance, and scalability.
Develop re-usable assets for the consulting teams on projects.
Develop customer-facing position papers, assets, and thought leadership presentations on architecture and innovation with Celonis.
Create technical designs and presentations for internal and client stakeholders.

The qualifications you need:

10 to 15 years of relevant experience (e.g., Software vendor Architect, CTO at a top consulting firm, or Enterprise Architect at a customer).
Proven ability to think strategically, connecting technical solutions to business value and customer objectives.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven track record of presenting complex technical concepts and strategic visions to C-level executives.
Demonstrated experience in Capability Mapping, Enterprise Modernization, and a strong understanding of Agentic AI
Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, SaaS solutions, ERP (particularly SAP), Salesforce, Dynamics CRM or ServiceNow), cybersecurity posture fundamentals, API ecosystems, along with legacy on-premise enterprise architectures.
Strong background in Data Architecture, Integrations patterns, and a development background in data-related languages (SQL, Python, etc.)
Strong technical background with a focus on system integrations, data operations, and automation capabilities.
The ability to comfortably switch from explaining an architecture diagram to an environment where you have coded or assembled a demo of that architecture.
MSc degree in Computer Science or an equivalent in an Information Technology-related field.
Fluency in English is required; Swedish or Danish would be an advantage.

Additional qualifications preferred:

Celonis Certifications and Experience with OCPM and Case Centric Data Pipelines.
AWS/Azure/GCP Certifications.
ESB / ETL Certifications (Mulesoft, Oracle, SAP, Talend, Informatica).
TOGAF/Zachmann Certification.
Experience in at least two domains among: Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Customer/Consumer Management (Service, Order Management, Sales), HR, Procurement.
Experience in at least two industries among: Consumer Goods, Banking, Pharma, Aerospace, Telco, Transport.

What Celonis can offer you:

Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description:
You’re an experienced AI architect who wants to turn applied AI into scalable, production-grade systems while helping clients create tangible business value.

As a senior consultant, you will work across the full lifecycle of applied AI, from strategy and architecture to implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement. You will help clients understand how AI affects their products, workflows, and technical systems, then turn those insights into solutions that are scalable, observable, and trustworthy.

Your time will be divided between client assignments and Knowit Connectivity’s AI Advisory Team. Together with senior AI specialists, architects, and business leaders, you will shape AI strategy, develop internal capabilities, evaluate emerging technologies, and establish practical ways of working with AI across the organization.

Your work may include:

Designing AI-native architectures and intelligent systems
Building and deploying LLM-based applications and RAG solutions in production
Creating agent-based workflows and autonomous system behaviors
Defining governance, observability, monitoring, and evaluation strategies
Integrating AI into existing products, platforms, and business processes
Guiding clients through technical and organizational decisions involving performance, reliability, cost, and control

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

You bring senior-level, hands-on experience in applied AI and can move comfortably between strategic discussions, architecture decisions, and implementation. You also understand the demands of consulting and can help clients navigate both technical and organizational challenges.

We believe your background includes several of the following:

Building production applications with large language models
Retrieval-Augmented Generation, vector databases, and complex information sources
Agent frameworks and orchestration platforms
System architecture, distributed systems, and large-scale software development
Python or a comparable programming language
Azure, AWS, or GCP, including evaluation, monitoring, and optimization of AI systems

Experience in enterprise architecture, platform engineering, or data engineering is highly valuable. You stay curious as the AI landscape evolves, apply new technology pragmatically, and recognize that strong AI systems require more than a successful prototype.

What can you expect from us?

You will solve real business problems with clients at different stages of AI maturity, from early exploration to implemented solutions. The assignments offer variety across projects and industries, giving you opportunities to build both breadth and depth over time.

Knowledge sharing is part of the everyday engineering culture. You will collaborate with experienced colleagues, influence client solutions, and contribute directly to how Knowit develops its AI capabilities and offerings. A formal development roadmap makes continuous AI learning and capability building part of your professional growth.

Application

If you have built real solutions with LLMs and want to help shape how AI is applied across engineering, products, and organizations, we would like to hear from you. Submit your application and tell us about the experience and perspective you would bring to the role.

About Knowit

Work with us at Knowit Connectivity, where we develop technically advanced systems within embedded and connected solutions. With us, you will work on complex products alongside experienced engineers on assignments at the forefront of technology.

Knowit is a Nordic consultancy that helps companies, public sector organizations, and businesses succeed in digital transformation. With expertise in software development, AI, cybersecurity, cloud services, digital customer experiences, and management consulting, we create solutions that contribute to a more sustainable and human-centered society.

We are approximately 3,700 employees working across our business areas – Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight, and Products – primarily in the Nordics, as well as in Poland, Serbia, and Germany.

We don’t wait for the future. We build it.

.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a strong .NET/Azure technical architect
with a proven track record of designing and delivering complex software solutions in an enterprise environment.

Extensive commercial experience with C#, .NET Framework and modern .NET
.
Strong practical experience designing and developing solutions on Microsoft Azure
.

services and cloud development patterns.

.

.

and modern software delivery practices.

and code-quality practices.

and their application within software solutions.

.
Experience working within large-scale enterprise or transformation programmes.
Experience establishing or evolving software architecture standards and governance.
Experience with proof-of-concept development and technology evaluation.

This is an opportunity to join a significant technology transformation environment where you'll have genuine scope to influence architecture, shape technical direction and work on complex enterprise solutions
.

jobs.title: Platform Engineering Manager - Design Engineering & Cloud Enablement (IRE)
jobs.description:
Reports To:
Head of IT – Platform Engineering
Direct Reports:
3-5
Location:
Citywest Business Campus (hybrid / 3 days per week in office)

About the role

The Platform Engineering Manager - Design Engineering & Cloud Enablement will lead architecture, cloud strategy, and network services across Inizio's corporate IT estate. You will set technical direction, governs standards, and lead senior engineers and architects designing solutions for the wider Platform Engineering organisation.
You will lead Design Engineering & Cloud Enablement and ensure Inizio's enterprise architecture remains consistent, scalable, secure, and supportable. You will translate technology strategy into practical engineering direction and develop a team operating as a true Centre for Enablement.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture Governance
Set engineering standards, architectural direction, and quality expectations across Inizio's enterprise platform estate.
Oversee architecture governance, ensuring you approve, and document solution designs through the appropriate processes.
Maintain reference architectures, technology standards, and Architecture Decision Records across cloud, network, identity, observability, and integration domains.
Assess the latest technologies and vendor capabilities, providing clear recommendations for Inizio's environment.
Embed security, resilience, supportability, and cost effectiveness into all architecture and engineering outputs.

Cloud Enablement & C4E Leadership
Lead Inizio's Centre for Enablement model, delivering reusable patterns, landing zones, golden paths, and engineering guardrails.
Oversee the cloud enablement strategy, driving Azure and AWS adoption following standards, security requirements, and the IT roadmap.
Oversee cloud engineering delivery across Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automation, and governance.
Provide leadership across the cloud and platform toolchain, including Azure, AWS, Entra ID, Boomi, ServiceNow integrations, and related controls.
Manage cloud vendor and managed service partner relationships.

People Management & Development
Manage senior engineers and architects through regular 1:1s, goals, performance reviews, and development conversations.
Build and sustain a collaborative team culture.
Identify skills gaps and develop plans to address them through recruitment, training, or professional development.
Act as a technical mentor across Platform Engineering.
Support workforce planning and succession activity.

Stakeholder Engagement & Roadmap
Shape and communicate the roadmap for the Design Engineering & Cloud Enablement with the Head of IT – Platform Engineering.
Translate business, security, architecture, and operational demand into priorities, reusable patterns, and standards.
Represent the function in architecture governance, service design, transition, and senior leadership forums.
Produce roadmaps, business cases, standards, and technical briefings to support decision-making.

Delivery & Operational Oversight
Ensure engineering delivery oversees work delivered to agreed time, quality, risk, and scope expectations.
Ensure architecture and cloud changes are governed, assessed, and ready for operational handover.

About you

Essential Experience
Experience in technical management or lead architecture within a complex enterprise IT environment.
Experience across Azure, AWS, enterprise networking, Entra ID, Boomi, and ServiceNow-aligned delivery and governance.
Experience leading senior technical teams across architecture, cloud, networks, or platform engineering.
Track record delivering cloud adoption, architecture transformation, or platform standardisation in a multi region enterprise.
Experience with reference architectures, design standards, service transition controls, and formal architecture review processes.
Experience operating in a Centre for Enablement, platform engineering, or reusable pattern model.

Qualifications
Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent senior-level professional experience.
Senior cloud or architecture certification expected, such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Google Professional Cloud Architect, TOGAF, or equivalent.
Additional qualifications in security, networking, IT service management, project delivery, or cloud financial management are advantageous, including AZ-500, CCNP, CISSP, ITIL, PRINCE2, FinOps, or equivalent.

Skills & Attributes
Credible technical leader able to set direction across cloud architecture, platform engineering, enterprise networking, identity, automation, observability, and security by design.
The ability to build, coach, motivate, and hold senior engineers and architects accountable for delivery, quality, and professional growth.
Can explain complex architecture choices, trade offs, risks, and benefits to senior, operational, security, finance, and technical team members.
Strategic and commercially aware, able to oversee cost, resilience, risk, compliance, vendor selection, platform investment, and long-term total cost of ownership.
Delivery-focused; able to balance governance with enablement and push adoption of reusable patterns, guardrails, automation, and continuous improvement.

Core competencies
Technical Leadership – Sets a credible technical direction and earns the respect of senior engineers and architects.
Can connect engineering decisions to the broader organisational technology strategy.
People Development – Invests in building team capability and creating an environment where engineers can do their best work.
Communication & Influence – Articulates complex technical ideas for varied audiences and builds effective stakeholder relationships.
Delivery Focus – Drives engineering outcomes with pace and quality.
Collaboration – Works as a genuine partner with the other Technical Managers and the Head of IT to deliver Platform Engineering as a unified function.
Commercial Awareness – Makes engineering decisions with an understanding of cost, risk, and business impact.

About Inizio

At Inizio, we're a global team motivated by a shared purpose: to reimagine health. Formed in 2022, we unite decades of experience and expertise with data, technology, and AI to create tailored solutions that drive Intelligent Commercialization™ at every stage of the journey - from discovery to post-launch.
Our global network of over 10,000 experts operates across 50 countries, supporting clients with strategic insight, medical excellence, creative engagement, and real-world delivery. We work with the world's leading health and life sciences businesses to solve complex challenges and accomplish meaningful outcomes for our clients and patients.
What sets Inizio apart is our people - and we believe everyone should excel. Here, you're encouraged to reimagine your possibilities: to grow, to be curious and to make change happen. We value your individuality, support your development, and celebrate your ambition. If you're ready to push boundaries and accelerate your career, Inizio is the best place to be.

Our Pledge

At Inizio, we value inclusivity, recognize the power of diversity and inspire the next generation of change-makers. We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe in creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity, equity and inclusion. We aim to recruit from a diverse slate of candidates and foster an environment that provides the right conditions for long-term success. We welcome all applications. We consider them regardless of race, color, religion, or belief. We also consider them regardless of gender, gender identity, age, national origin, marital status, military veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, and physical or mental disability.

Artificial Intelligence

Inizio may use AI technologies to support certain aspects of our recruitment process, but all hiring decisions at Inizio are made by our human recruiting team. We are committed to fair, inclusive, and human-led hiring practices.

Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

We are currently looking for a Senior Software Developer or Software Architect to join our Intelligent Devices team and play a key role at the intersection of technology and business.

Manufacturing industries are living in an era of accelerated change and rapid demand for renewal. Industrial digitalization, green transition and recent volatility in economics are shaping the way organizations create value and interact with each other. The future of many traditional hardware businesses lies in software. Our mission is to help manufacturing businesses turn change into a competitive advantage with comprehensive digital expertise that combines technology, data and human insight. Our industry customer portfolio consists of large enterprises and corporations from asset intensive process industries to world-class intelligent equipment OEMs.

As our business is constantly growing, we are now recruiting new team members to our Intelligent Devices team. This team delivers various software solutions for our clients in industrial domain by creating solutions for intelligent devices such as drones, forest machinery and other industrial solutions. Projects may vary from web software development projects to Industrial IoT and Edge Computing projects. You can choose your preferred work location from any of the following locations: Helsinki, Jyväskylä, Kuopio, Lahti, Oulu, Tampere
or Turku
.

Your role as a Senior Software Developer

In this role, you will develop and maintain secure and scalable software solutions for our industrial customers. You will help translate customer needs into practical technical solutions and provide hands-on expertise throughout the project lifecycle—from early problem definition to implementation and continuous improvement.

As an experienced developer, you also take part in architectural decisions that ensure high-quality, reliable delivery at project level. You work closely with customers and teams, combining strong technical skills with a consultative approach to ensure solutions meet both business and technical goals. We will discuss the exact scope and focus of your role based on your experience, skills, and interests. Depending on your level of experience and responsibility, your monthly salary will range between 5200-6200€.

What we expect from you

Several years of relevant experience in middleware software development using some of the following technologies: Java/Kotlin, C#, TypeScript, Python, or Go.
Strong experience with public cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
Previous experience in software development projects related to IoT, or Edge Computing.
You are a trusted advisor to customers: capable of communicating complex technical concepts clearly, challenging assumptions constructively, and guiding stakeholders towards technology decisions that align with business objectives and create long-term value.
Familiarity with key industrial technologies and platforms such as Azure IoT Hub, AWS IoT Core, Kubernetes, KubeEdge, OPC UA, MQTT, and Crosser is highly beneficial.
Interest in the opportunities enabled by artificial intelligence, along with practical experience using AI either in a professional or personal context.

Your Role as a Software Architect

As a Software Architect, your responsibilities include the design and development of software solutions as well as providing technical leadership to project teams. You will work closely with both customers and project teams to develop solutions that address customer needs. You will support, challenge, and guide customers in focusing on the right problems, with the goal of delivering maximum business value.

In addition to project work, you will have the opportunity to influence future projects by supporting sales activities as a technical expert. This includes assisting with proposal preparation, participating in customer meetings, and performing requirements definition and architecture design activities. We will discuss the exact scope and focus of your role based on your experience, skills, and interests. Depending on your level of experience and responsibility, your monthly salary will range between 5700-6700€.

In addition to the software development competencies above, we also expect you to:

Have experience working in a hands-on Software Architect role, with the ability to define and design the technical foundations and architecture of projects.
Act as a bridge between business and technology by translating customers’ business requirements into robust, sustainable technical solutions.
Have participated in pre-sales discussions with prospective and existing customers in the role of a technical expert, and be motivated to contribute as part of a team during proposal and tender processes.

Why join Solita?

This is an opportunity to work on demanding industrial software projects where modern software development meets real-world complexity. As Solita’s customer portfolio is versatile, you also have the opportunity to work in projects for other domains.
At Solita, we value expertise and give you room to make an impact. As a Senior Software Developer or Software Architect, you won’t just focus on implementation: you’ll also contribute to technical direction, architectural decisions, and collaboration with customers. Depending on your role and interests, you can deepen your hands-on technical work, take more architectural responsibility, and help shape the technologies and practices used in projects.
You’ll join a community of talented professionals who combine strong technical competence with a pragmatic, consultative way of working. We believe the best results are built together, through trust, knowledge sharing and a low-hierarchy culture where people genuinely support one another.
At the same time, we want work to be sustainable in the long run. That means opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth, flexibility in how your career develops, and a genuine respect for balance between work and free time.

Let's talk more!

If you want to join our growing and caring team of professionals, please send your free-form application today!
Our recruitment consists of two rounds of interviews where you will meet our team and learn more about working at Solita. You will be given the opportunity to show your skills and ask us questions. The purpose is to get to know each other better.
Any thoughts or questions, please reach out to our recruiter Essi Heino (essi.heino@solita.fi).

As a key technology, data, and design partner, Solita’s business is built on trust and responsibility. For this reason, the selected candidate’s identity and employment background will be verified. These checks are carried out in accordance with and within the limits of the Act on the Protection of Privacy in Working Life.

In addition, employment in this role may require a security clearance if requested by our customer. The security clearance is conducted in accordance with the Finnish Security Clearance Act. Successful completion of the security clearance is required for the role.

Työskentelemään itseohjautuvasti osana ketterää tiimiä läheisessä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden kanssa.
Kehittymään ja kasvamaan urallasi sekä vaikuttamaan projektien ja oman työsi suuntaan.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Sinulla on kokemusta turvaluokitellusta työskentelystä tai projektikokemusta Goforen ydinalueilta, kuten digitaalisesta yhteiskunnasta (julkinen sektori, vähittäiskauppa ja palvelut, terveys, turvallisuus) tai älykkäästä teollisuudesta (kone- ja laitevalmistus, tuotantoteollisuus)
Kokemusta tekoälyavusteisuudesta ja agenttisesta ohjelmistokehityksestä
Vähintään 8 vuoden ajalta monipuolista kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä konsulttina

Vähintään 3 vuoden ajalta kokemusta relaatiotietokannoista (esim. PostgreSQL tai Microsoft SQL Server)
Vähintään 3 vuoden ajalta kokemusta AWS- tai Azure-pilvialustasta ja DevOps-käytänteiden osaamista
Hyviä konsulttitaitoja ja kokemusta asiakasprojekteissa konsulttina toimimisesta eli asiakaslähtöistä asennetta sekä kykyä kommunikoida selkeästi eri alojen asiantuntijoiden kanssa
Valmiutta työskennellä asiakkaan pyytäessä asiakkaan tiloissa osana kehitystiimiä
Erinomainen suomen kielen taito konsulttityössä

Tehtävään valitulle voidaan tehdä henkilöturvallisuusselvitys, jos asiakasprojekti sitä vaatii.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Hyvinvoivat työntekijät ja sujuvan arjen luominen ovat Goforen ydin. Haluamme olla työyhteisö, jossa työn tekeminen on innostavaa, palkitsevaa ja ammatillista osaamista kasvattavaa. Maineemme laadukkaiden palveluiden tuottamisessa asiakkaillemme on yksinomaan huippuasiantuntijoidemme ansiota. Asiakastyytyväisyys on meille tärkeää ja NPS:mme onkin korkea, 62 (2025). Goforelaiset saavatkin erityisen hyvää palautetta asiakaslähtöisestä asenteesta. Työntekijätyytyväisyytemme perustuu tutkitusti osaavaan yhteisöön ja yhdessä tekemiseen.

Olemme ylpeitä läpinäkyvästä toimintakulttuuristamme, pioneerihenkisyydestämme sekä siitä että olemassaolollamme on suurempi tarkoitus kuin pelkästään voiton tuottaminen - pyrkimys inhimillisempään, kestävämpään ja eettisempään digimaailmaan ja työelämään. Meillä pääset osaksi yhteisöä jossa olet lähellä oman osaamisalueesi muita osaajia ja samalla läheisesti töitä tehden toisten huippuosaajien kanssa asiakasprojektissa. Olemme organisoituneet asiakaslähtöisesti, mikä mahdollistaa yksilö- ja tiimionnistumisten näkyväksi tekemisen ja oman osaamisen kasvattamisen vaikkapa toimiala edellä.

Goforelaisten yhteisöllisyys ulottuu myös työn ulkopuolelle erilaisten aktiviteettien kuten toimistotapahtumien, lautapelien ja perhepäivien muodossa. Jotta työ ja vapaa-aika löytäisivät tarvitsemasi tasapainon, tarjoamme sinulle joustavat työskentelyolosuhteet ja työvälineet, jotka saat valita tarpeidesi mukaan.

Edellä mainittujen lisäksi meillä on kattavat etuudet. Goforella on käytössä oma, tekijöidemme näköinen työehtosopimus. Voit tutustua siihen täällä.

Palkkakehitys

Meille Goforella on tärkeää, että työstä maksetaan kunnollinen kokonaiskorvaus. Palkkaan vaikuttaa paitsi kokemus ja taidot, myös kaksi arvoamme: aktiiviset toimet sen eteen, että Gofore on hyvä työpaikka kaikille sekä asiakasnäkökulman huomioiminen kaikessa tekemisessä. Oman esihenkilön kanssa käytävissä palkkakeskusteluissa keskeistä on saamasi palaute, laskutusaste (olemmehan konsultteja!) sekä oman osaamisen kehittäminen.

Tyypillisesti palkkataso tässä roolissa asettuu välille 4500-6000 eur/kk. Kiinteän palkan lisäksi meillä on käytössä kuukausittaiseen laskutukseesi perustuvat bonukset. Määrittelemme sopivan palkkatason keskustelujen edetessä, kun tiedämme osaamisestasi tarkemmin.

Huomioimme mielellämme neurodiversiteetin vaatimukset rekrytointiprosessissa ja tarvittaessa muokkaamme prosessia tarpeidesi mukaisesti .

jobs.title: Senior Solution/Technical Architect
jobs.description:
Liiketoiminta ja teknologia puhuvat usein eri kieltä, ja hyvä arkkitehti osaa molempia. Nyt etsimme kokeneita arkkitehteja kahdella näkökulmalla: liiketoimintalähtöisiä ratkaisuarkkitehtuuriin erikoistuneita ja tekniseen järjestelmäarkkitehtuuriin erikoistuneita asiantuntijoita.

Jos tunnistat itsesi jommastakummasta, saatat olla etsimämme asiantuntija:

Senior Solution Architect:
Lähdet liikkeelle asiakkaan liiketoiminnan tarpeista ja muutat tavoitteet toimiviksi, kustannustehokkaiksi ja toteutettaviksi kokonaisratkaisuiksi. Vertailet vaihtoehtoja, laadit tiekarttoja ja toimit siltana johdon, liiketoiminnan ja kehitystiimien välillä. Osaat perustella valintasi sekä kehitystiimille että johdolle. Kokemusta sinulla on vähintään 8 vuotta ja toimit projekteissa omaan asiantuntijuuteesi luottaen.

Senior Technical Architect:
Suunnittelet järjestelmiä, jotka kestävät kuormaa, muutoksia ja aikaa. Taustasi on ohjelmistokehityksessä, ja huomioit valinnoissasi skaalautuvuuden, suorituskyvyn, tietoturvan ja ylläpidettävyyden. Osaat myös tunnistaa teknisen velan ja modernisoida järjestelmiä hallitusti. Perustelet valintasi yhtä selkeästi kehitystiimille ja johdolle sekä jaat osaamistasi käytännönläheisesti. Kokemusta sinulla on vähintään 8 vuotta ja toimit projekteissa omaan asiantuntijuuteesi luottaen. 
Saatat etsiä seuraavaa työpaikkaasi tai seuraavaa projektiasi yrittäjänä.

Millaista osaamista etsimme

Vähintään 8 vuoden kokemusta ratkaisu-, kokonais- tai järjestelmäarkkitehtuurista tai ohjelmistokehityksestä
Kokemusta arkkitehtuurin suunnittelusta ja dokumentoinnista
Kokemusta liiketoimintatarpeiden ja vaatimusten muuttamisesta toimiviksi ratkaisuiksi
Ymmärrystä pilvipalveluista, integraatioista, data-arkkitehtuurista ja tietoturvasta
Kokemusta ratkaisuvaihtoehtojen ja teknologioiden arvioinnista ja vertailusta
Erinomaisia viestintä- ja sidosryhmätaitoja sekä kykyä toimia itsenäisesti asiakasprojekteissa
Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen julkisen sektorin hankinnoista, legacy-järjestelmien modernisointi- ja migraatioprojekteista, JHS 179 -menetelmän ja julkisen sektorin tietoturvavaatimusten (esim. Julkri) tuntemuksen sekä arkkitehtuuriin liittyvät sertifikaatit (esim. TOGAF, Azure Solutions Architect Expert tai AWS Certified Solutions Architect)

Arvostamme kokemusta esimerkiksi seuraavista menetelmistä ja teknologioista: TOGAF, ArchiMate, BPMN, C4-malli, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Terraform, Kafka, REST, API Management, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce

Emme oleta, että osaat kaikkia listattuja menetelmiä ja teknologioita. Jos sinulla on vahva kokemus arkkitehtuurista, kuulemme sinusta mielellämme! Kerrothan meille hakemuksessasi, kumpi rooli on sinulle luontevampi, ja kerro tarkemmin juuri sinun vahvuuksistasi.

Mahdollisia työtehtäviäsi

Asiakkaan liiketoimintatavoitteiden, tarpeiden ja vaatimusten kartoittaminen
Kokonaisratkaisujen ja teknisen arkkitehtuurin suunnitteleminen
Pilvi-, integraatio- ja data-arkkitehtuurin suunnitteleminen
Teknologia- ja toimittajavalintojen arvioiminen ja perusteleminen
Tiekarttojen, arkkitehtuurikuvausten ja päätöksenteon tukimateriaalien laatiminen
Olemassa olevien järjestelmien arvioiminen ja modernisoinnin suunnitteleminen
Kehitystiimien ohjaaminen ja arkkitehtuurikatselmointien tekeminen
Yhteistyö asiakkaan johdon, liiketoiminnan, kehittäjien ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa
Oman osaamisen jakaminen ja muiden asiantuntijoiden sparraaminen

Prosessi ja palkkaus

Käymme kaikki hakemukset läpi ja vastaamme jokaiselle. Tutustumme sinuun CV:n tai LinkedIn-profiilisi kautta ja käymme myös nykyiset projektimme läpi. Mikäli projekteistamme saattaisi nyt tai lähitulevaisuudessa löytyä sinulle sopiva toimeksianto, kutsumme sinut tutustumistapaamiseen. Kun sinulle mahdollisesti sopiva asiakasprojekti löytyy, ja asiakas kiinnostuu osaamisestasi, haluaa hän useimmiten haastatella sinut kerran tai pari ennen lopullisen päätöksensä tekemistä. Mikäli asiakas haluaa sinut konsultikseen, pääsemme tekemään tarvittavat sopimukset: joko työsopimuksen tai alihankintasopimuksen, mikäli toimit mieluummin yrittäjänä.

Palkka määräytyy kokemuksen ja projektin perusteella välille 5000-8000+ €/kk. Halutessasi voit valita kiinteän tai laskutettuihin tunteihin perustuvan palkkamallin. Jos toimit alihankkijana, on tuntilaskutus useimmiten 60-100+ €/h.

Lisätietoa meistä

Marvel Consulting on noin 30 hengen asiantuntijatiimi, ja me kasvamme jatkuvasti! 🚀 Etsimme IT-alan osaajille mielenkiintoisia konsultointiprojekteja erilaisten asiakkaidemme parista. Työskentelemme pääosin vaativissa IT-projekteissa tukemalla asiakkaitamme heidän hankkeissaan, joihin liittyvät toimeksiannot kestävät usein kuukausia tai jopa vuosia. Asiakkaamme vaihtelevat pienyrityksistä startupeihin ja suuryrityksiin sekä julkisiin toimijoihin.

Kilpailukykyisen palkan
Erittäin osaavat (ja mukavat!) kollegat
Mielenkiintoisia ja merkityksellisiä projekteja
Hyvät työsuhde-edut sekä laajan työterveyden
Toiveiden mukaiset ja projektin tarpeisiin vastaavat työvälineet

jobs.title: Associate Consultant – AI & Engineering
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
We are looking for students who are on their bachelors or masters that want to work on exciting projects, with fantastic colleagues and the newest technologies while providing value to our clients in the health industry.

Are you our new Associate Consultant within AI & Engineering?

We are looking for energetic, proactive, and curious Associates who want to be part of an exciting journey.

Associate Consultants at Intellishore play a vital role in our business. From the beginning, you will apply and develop your analytical, interpersonal, and development skills. You will work side by side with skilled consultants and contribute to a creative and contemporary company culture, where the skills and inputs of all employees are greatly valued.

You will get the chance to immerse yourself into some of the newest technologies whilst gaining an in-depth understanding of specific business challenges in the health industry, as you engage with clients in close collaboration with your dedicated Intellishore project team.

Our projects can be everything from actionable data and AI strategies, data architecture designs to advanced AI/ML models and scalable enterprise data platforms. Flexible and collaborative, we're not bound to any single technology or framework. You can read about some of our cases here: https://www.intellishore.dk/cases.

Our organization is structured around two tribes, Strategy & Transformation and AI & Engineering, working hand in hand on every project. We cross-staff dynamically, assembling cross-functional teams tailored to each project's needs. You'll be based in the AI & Engineering tribe.

Who is Intellishore?

Intellishore is founded in 2013, and is now home to 85+ passionate specialists in strategy, AI, and data, working from our Copenhagen and Zurich offices. We help and advise leading healthcare clients to shape the future of health, working with partners across the ecosystem to unlock the full potential of data and AI. Read more about our vision for Health 3.0 here: https://www.intellishore.dk/health.

We are builders who believe in an open and honest approach to consulting. We ask questions, stand by our beliefs, and cut through complexity to create clarity. For us, progress doesn’t come from technology alone - it happens when the right people have the right data, strategy, and tools to act. As a collective of developers and strategists, we bring energy, expertise, and a passion for helping our clients succeed.

Read more about our team here: https://www.intellishore.dk/about

What are we looking for in our new technical Associate?

We realize that you are still learning and need support, but you also need responsibilities that will push you further and develop your skills in the realm of digital transformation and healthcare.

As you will be supporting our experienced consultants on multiple cases no day is the same, but here is what you can expect and what we are looking for:

Natural flair for relation-building, stakeholder management, and communication
Work with either data science and data engineering and a wide range of technologies such as Python, Azure, GenAI, ML, LLMs etc.
Academic background in e.g. IT, engineering, or economics from CBS, ITU, DTU, KU
Part-time (Approximately 15-20 hours a week)
Preferably you have approx. two years remaining of your studies

As you develop skills and confidence, you will increase your responsibilities, and we will help you grow by tailoring a career model that urges you to apply the skills you already have and those you will gain at Intellishore.

Development is at the core of Intellishore, and we have dedicated plans for each Intellishorian and internal academy sessions for upskilling and knowledge sharing. You will also get the opportunity to influence and drive parts of the business development of Intellishore to ensure we keep getting better at delivering value to our clients.

What can we offer you?

1 | Challenging projects

Exciting and challenging consultant role in strategic and technical client projects

2 | Entrepreneurial work environment

A dynamic and entrepreneurial environment with ambitious colleagues

3 | Exciting industry

Unique opportunity to get a deep insight into the world of AI, Data & Analytics!

4 | Strategic seminars

Strategic seminars (previous years we've been to Germany, Italy, UK, Iceland and France)

5 | Flexibility

We offer a high level of flexibility in the position for you to balance your studies and work-life

6 | Amazing colleagues

Everyone talks about having a lot of social events but we don't need it, we just love spending time together!

Strategic Seminar

Every year all the Intellishorians leave behind their daily tasks to assemble for the annual Strategic Seminar to experience a change in scenery, strengthen their abilities to work together as a team, and gather inspiration to help set the overall direction of Intellishore and the work we do for our clients.

Just one more time. Why should I join Intellishore?

GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

CCYC (Culture, Community and Youth Cluster) is a part of GovTech's Government Digital Transformation team where we support the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth (MCCY) and its statutory boards — such as the National Arts Council (NAC), People’s Association (PA), Sport Singapore (SportSG), and Islamic Religious Council of Singapore (MUIS)
— by delivering digital solutions that promote social cohesion, cultural vibrancy, and youth engagement.

[What you will be working on]

As a Software Engineer, You Will

Lead the design, development, and implementation of complex, scalable, and secure software applications across the full software development lifecycle.
Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers to define requirements, architect solutions, and deliver high-quality products.
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code in various programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go, JavaScript, C#).
Conduct code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and mentor junior engineers to foster a culture of technical excellence.
Troubleshoot and debug production issues, ensuring high availability and performance of critical systems.
Contribute to technical documentation, architectural diagrams, and best practices.
Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends, evaluating their potential application within GovTech's ecosystem.
Participate in agile development processes, including stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.

You're not just here to write code, but also to figure out what we should be building and how we should build it. You will work on meaningful projects that solve problems pertinent to our society. The public sector is full of opportunities where even the simplest software can have a big impact on people’s lives. Rather than work on commercial ventures commonly found in the startup scene, we're here to improve how we live as a society through what we can offer as a government.

Your job will be to bring expertise and capability to the public sector. Sometimes this means coding new systems from scratch. Other times this means using the best solutions the development community has to offer. We use cloud services, open-source software, and commodity hardware as far as possible. These often include, but are not limited to: GitHub, AWS, React Native, MongoDB, and Stripe amongst others. Knowing what to build and what to reuse lets us avoid wasting time on solved problems and focus on delivering actual value.

[What we are looking for]

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in software development with a strong track record of delivering successful projects
Experience in Mobile Application and Website Development, Content Management System (CMS)
Proficiency in at least two modern programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go, JavaScript, C#) and experience with relevant frameworks.
Solid understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.
Web development with Node.js background, preferably with Next.js and AI-assisted development
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical challenges and propose effective solutions.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
Experience working on government or public sector projects is a plus.
A strong passion for public service and leveraging technology for the betterment of society.
Overall, we look for people who have ability, initiative, good communication, and strong values.

What we offer you:

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation.   

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs. 

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you. 

Please note that this will be a 2-year fixed term contract.

jobs.title: Architect
jobs.description:
Your role at Dynatrace

The Professional Services Architect is accountable for the technical integrity, delivery viability, and customer outcomes of complex Dynatrace engagements. The role combines architecture, consulting, and implementation leadership to design scalable, supportable, and commercially viable solutions that help customers achieve their observability, automation, and digital transformation goals.

Working across customers, partners, and internal teams, the Architect defines solution strategies, implementation roadmaps, governance models, and operational standards while ensuring commitments are achievable before they are made. The role also strengthens delivery capability by mentoring consultants, promoting best practice, and contributing to the evolution of Dynatrace Professional Services methodologies and architectural standards.

Key Responsibilities

Lead customer discovery sessions, architecture workshops, and technical advisory engagements to understand business objectives, technical requirements, operational challenges, and success criteria.
Design and govern scalable Dynatrace solutions and deployment architectures across enterprise, cloud, and cloud-native environments, ensuring alignment with customer requirements and industry best practices.
Own the architectural quality and delivery readiness of assigned engagements, ensuring solutions are scalable, supportable, commercially viable, and aligned to measurable customer outcomes.
Define implementation strategies, onboarding approaches, governance models, operational standards, and transition plans that support long-term platform adoption and success.
Advise customers on observability strategies and the effective use of Dynatrace capabilities and ecosystem integrations to improve operational resilience, service performance, and business outcomes.
Architect and guide integrations between Dynatrace and enterprise platforms, including cloud services, ITSM solutions, security tools, CI/CD pipelines, and other operational systems.
Provide architectural leadership for RFP, RFI, and proposal engagements by defining solution strategies, validating requirements, and contributing to scope, estimates, assumptions, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and delivery risk—ensuring commitments are achievable before they are made to the customer.
Collaborate with Product, Support, Engineering, and other internal stakeholders to address complex customer requirements, technical escalations, and product improvement opportunities.
Mentor consultants, partners, and technical teams by reviewing solution designs, sharing best practices, developing reusable assets, and driving delivery excellence across the organization.
Maintain expertise in modern observability, cloud-native technologies, automation, security, and operational best practices to provide trusted architectural guidance and thought leadership.

What Will Help You Succeed

Typically 8+ years of relevant experience in enterprise technology consulting, solution architecture, observability, platform engineering, SRE, cloud, application performance, or IT operations, including ownership of complex customer engagements.
Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering enterprise-scale solutions across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Deep practical knowledge of modern application architectures, including microservices, containers, Kubernetes, serverless, APIs, distributed systems, messaging, databases, and common enterprise middleware.
Strong understanding of telemetry and observability standards, including OpenTelemetry, OTLP, logs, metrics, traces, events, topology, service-level objectives, and data-quality practices.
Working knowledge of software delivery and operations practices, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, GitOps, SRE, incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, and DevSecOps.
Ability to create clear architecture diagrams, decision records, implementation plans, governance models, executive narratives, and technical documentation.
Ability to lead structured workshops, manage competing priorities, communicate risks, influence without authority, and present credibly from engineering teams to C-level executives.
Commercial and delivery acumen, including scope control, estimation, assumptions, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and value-based outcome definition.
Relevant industry certifications across cloud, observability, automation, security, IT operations, or delivery are highly regarded, alongside demonstrated practical expertise.
Obtain Dynatrace Associate Certification within 2 months of joining and Dynatrace Professional Certification within 6 months of joining.
Commitment to continuous learning and maintaining relevant technical certifications.

Desired Experience

Architecture or transformation experience in regulated industries, government, financial services, telecommunications, or other complex enterprise environments.
Experience designing enterprise observability operating models, centers of excellence, platform-product models, or governance frameworks.
Experience with ServiceNow, major cloud platforms, Kubernetes platforms, OpenTelemetry, automation/orchestration, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and security ecosystems.
Experience with executive value realization, adoption measurement, ROI narratives, quarterly business reviews, and outcome-based roadmaps.
Contributions to technical communities through reusable assets, enablement, white papers, conference sessions, blogs, or mentoring.

Travel And Development Requirements

Occasional customer-site, regional, or training travel may be required, subject to business need and local policy.
Continuous professional development is expected to maintain currency in the Dynatrace platform and relevant industry technologies.
The role may participate in field observation, strategic customer workshops, internal enablement, and industry events.

Why you will love being a Dynatracer

Dynatrace is a leader in unified observability and security.
We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance.
Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances.
You'll get to work at the forefront of innovation with Dynatrace Intelligence—the industry's first agentic operations system. Bringing together deterministic and agentic AI, it helps teams understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next— automatically.
Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace.
