jobs.title: Senior Architect (Agentic AI & Automations)
jobs.description:
The Agentic AI Automations Architect
is the senior technical authority for the design and delivery of conversational and agentic automations that resolve enterprise service requests across IT and Customer Service. Working on a modern Agentic AI Platform from our Partner, the Architect remains substantially hands-on, building and delivering to assigned customer accounts, while also owning the overall solution architecture, setting the patterns and standards the team builds to, and shaping solutions with customers from first conversation through to live production.

Key responsibilities:

Architect and build conversational and process automations
that collect from and act in external systems via platform connectors or direct API calls, covering knowledge retrieval, service request fulfilment, identity and access tasks, and guided troubleshooting, with safe handover to a live support experts.
Build agentic automations driven by prompts and function libraries
, defining the integrations, functions, and actions an automation can use so the generated prompt template selects the right function and populates its parameters from the request and connected data. The skill is in applying the LLM where it adds value while keeping flow logic explicit through designed nodes, branches, and decisions.
Own reference architectures, patterns, and standards for the Agentic AI platform
at expert level, translating each customer's context into the right design, judging which capabilities to apply for their environment, systems, constraints, and objectives, and curating proven, reusable patterns, flows, and components into a shared library the whole team designs and builds against.
Own the solution architecture for assigned accounts
, from solutioning through to live, supported production, engaging stakeholders directly to gather requirements, agree approach, and demonstrate value; owning design decisions and trade-offs and documenting them so the solution is defensible and maintainable; and overseeing build, deployment, and administration in the customer's environment, whether built personally or delivered with Engineers.
Map and integrate the customer's system landscape
, including systems of record (ITSM), identity directories, collaboration and productivity suites such as Microsoft 365, endpoint and digital-experience tooling, and CRM, ERP and HR systems, along with the data sources behind them, identifying the source of truth for each.
Work fluently across hosting topologies
, from public cloud (strong emphasis on Microsoft Azure) to private cloud, on-premises data centres, and hybrid combinations, and within the customer's network and connectivity boundaries.
Design identity and access integration
, connecting to the customer's identity provider for authentication, single sign-on, and federation with role-based, least-privilege access so automations act with auditable permissions and as the right user where needed.
Act as design authority
, deciding where each piece of logic and data should live, whether to use the platform, Azure, or a customer system for a given capability, and designing integrations resilient to the customer upgrading or replacing systems. Review the designs of Engineers, give clear technical direction, and keep solutions consistent with the team's reference architectures.
Raise the capability of the team
, mentoring Engineers, running design and code reviews, sharing reusable assets and good practice, and helping to evolve the way the CoE designs, builds, and delivers, all through influence rather than line management.
Use Microsoft Azure to complement and extend the platform
, filling gaps and fine-tuning where the platform alone is not sufficient. Apply Azure-native AI and agent services, in particular Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, its agent capabilities, model catalogue, and grounding and retrieval, both as an equivalent Agentic AI capability and a complement in Microsoft-heavy environments. Build supporting components (serverless functions, integration and workflow services, API gateways, event messaging) for orchestration, custom logic, and data preparation.
Evaluate capabilities and inform the technical roadmap
, assessing new Agentic AI and innovation features, Azure and Azure AI Foundry services, models, and emerging standards, running proofs of concept where useful; what to standardise on, and how the overall architecture should evolve.
Embed enterprise security throughout
, including zero-trust principles, secure handling of secrets and credentials, encryption in transit and at rest, PII masking, and content access controls per enterprise and regulatory requirements.
Test, deploy, and continuously improve
, with functional and reliability testing of real conversations and edge cases before production, promoting automations through development, test, and production environments under the customer's change process, and using analytics, unresolved-request review, and user feedback to increase automation and containment rates.

Required Skills and Experience:

Substantial hands-on experience designing and building Agentic AI automations
or integrations on an enterprise conversational AI or agentic AI platform, or strong transferable experience in workflow automation and systems integration, with a track record of owning solution architecture, not only building to someone else's design. This includes designing agentic automations where a model selects and calls functions while the flow logic stays explicit and controlled.
Confident scripting for automation work
, in particular JavaScript, with strong JSON handling (parsing, building, and transforming payloads) and data mapping between systems using approaches such as JSON-path mapping and JOLT-style transformations.
Strong enterprise architecture experience
, with proven ability to design solutions across real customer environments: networks, servers, core enterprise services, and the mix of cloud, on-premises, and hybrid hosting most organisations run, Microsoft infrastructure prominent among them. Comfortable producing reference architectures and articulating design decisions and trade-offs to technical and senior audiences.
Experience integrating with enterprise business applications and systems of record
(ITSM and ticketing such as ServiceNow, CRM, ERP, HR, etc), including reading and writing to them and understanding their data models, permissions, and constraints.
Strong Microsoft Azure cloud expertise
: identity with Microsoft Entra ID, networking (virtual networks, network security groups, private endpoints, firewalls, hybrid connectivity), and core compute, integration, data, and AI services. This includes using Azure to complement and extend the Agentic AI platform capabilities.
Expertise
working with Azure AI Foundry to build or ground agents and use its model catalogue, particularly in Microsoft-heavy environments.
Strong integration skills across multiple mechanisms
: REST APIs, webhooks, authentication and authorisation flows, including OAuth 2.0 in its common grant types, with token lifecycle and refresh handling, JSON, and event or message-driven patterns. Comfortable onboarding third-party APIs, with exposure to integration and middleware platforms.
Experience deploying and operating integration components across hybrid and on-premises environments, including Windows-hosted services or containers with secure outbound connectivity to SaaS.
Experience delivering conversational chat and voice channels into environments such as Microsoft Teams, embedded web chat.
Practical LLM skills for enterprise use, including prompt engineering and prompt management, selecting and configuring hosted models, RAG and grounding in trusted data, intent classification and entity or value extraction, knowledge ontology and synonym tuning, and evaluating model quality and reliability.
Experience shaping, scoping, and estimating engagements
, running discovery with customers, advising on feasibility and approach, and supporting sales and pre-sales with solution outlines, architectures, and effort estimates that can be costed and committed to.
Technical leadership and mentoring
, acting as design authority, running design and code reviews, setting standards, and raising the capability of engineers through influence rather than formal line management.
A high degree of autonomy and ownership
, able to own architecture across multiple customer accounts in parallel, act as the senior technical point of escalation, and take responsibility for solution quality and outcomes.

Desirable:

Prior experience in a solution architect, technical lead, or principal engineer role, ideally in a consultancy, managed-service, or multi-customer delivery setting.
Experience with one or more leading agentic AI or conversational automation platforms like UiPath or AutomationAnywhere, with adaptability to transfer skills to a new toolset.
Experience delivering in regulated or enterprise environments where governance, auditability, and access control matter, including Microsoft-heavy estates.
Relevant Microsoft certifications, in particular Azure Solutions Architect, alongside Azure administration, Azure AI, identity, and security, or equivalent demonstrable experience.
Emerging agent-interoperability standards such as the MCP, A2A, etc.

jobs.description:
Power Platform & Azure DevOps Engineer

B2B contractor | Part-time or Full-time | Remote
Medior to Senior | 4+ years cloud or DevOps engineering
Azure DevOps YAML | Power Platform & Dynamics 365 ALM | Bicep / Terraform

About the job

CG Tech Labs builds and supports business-critical software through experienced engineering teams. For this engagement, you will join a Microsoft business-applications team that delivers Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure solutions for multiple customers.
We are looking for a Power Platform & Azure DevOps Engineer to design, build and maintain the deployment pipelines and cloud automation behind these solutions. The goal is to standardise how Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure changes move from development through TEST and UAT to production.
This is a hands-on engineering role. It suits someone who writes and troubleshoots automation themselves, turns technical and operational requirements into reusable, secure pipelines, and can explain their decisions to consultants, developers and infrastructure specialists.

Your role with us

Build reusable Azure DevOps YAML pipelines for Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions.
Automate Azure infrastructure through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep and/or Terraform).
Help consultants and engineers onboard new customer projects onto shared, documented templates.

What you will actually do

Power Platform & Dynamics 365 ALM

Design and maintain YAML pipelines for Dynamics 365 Sales, Dataverse and Power Platform solutions.
Automate solution export, unpacking, versioning, validation, packaging and deployment with Power Platform Build Tools and the Power Platform CLI.
Promote managed solutions across TEST, UAT and PROD on a build-once, deploy-many basis.
Configure environment-specific deployment settings, including environment variables and connection references.
Add quality gates: Solution Checker, approvals, deployment checks, smoke tests and release traceability.
Support solutions containing plug-ins, custom workflow assemblies, PCF controls, Power Automate flows and model-driven apps.
Contribute to deployment automation for PPAC-managed Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations environments.

Azure DevOps & automation

Create modular YAML templates reusable across customers and projects, keeping templates, customer configuration and secrets clearly separated.
Configure repositories, branch policies, pull-request validation, artifacts, environments, approvals and service connections.
Implement secure authentication using workload identity federation or service principals.
Troubleshoot pipeline, authentication, permission and deployment failures.
Document onboarding, operational and recovery procedures.

Azure Infrastructure as Code

Design and maintain Bicep and/or Terraform, with reusable modules for common Azure resources and customer environments.
Build pipelines that validate, preview (Bicep what-if / Terraform plan) and deploy infrastructure changes.
Apply naming, tagging, security, identity and governance standards, and keep secrets out of source control.
Support controlled promotion of infrastructure changes across environments.

Azure engineering (depending on experience and project needs)

Configure App Services, Function Apps, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, Storage, Application Insights and Log Analytics.
Implement managed identities and role-based access control.
Assist with monitoring, diagnostics and cost optimisation.
Investigate integration, networking, identity and deployment issues together with consultants and developers.

In your first months

Deliver a working Sales / Dataverse pipeline from source control to a non-production environment.
Turn it into reusable, documented templates with validation, approvals and security controls.
Build or improve an Azure Infrastructure as Code deployment pipeline.
Produce documentation that another engineer can operate and maintain.

What we are looking for

Hands-on experience building Azure DevOps YAML pipelines.
Git, branching strategies and pull-request workflows.
Practical Power Platform, Dataverse or Dynamics 365 ALM experience, including deploying solutions between environments.
Real-project experience with at least one Infrastructure as Code technology, preferably Bicep or Terraform.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, service principals, managed identities, workload identity federation and RBAC.
PowerShell or Azure CLI scripting.
Ability to troubleshoot independently using pipeline logs, platform logs and Microsoft documentation.
Strong written and spoken English, and the ability to document technical solutions clearly.

Nice to have

Power Platform Build Tools and Power Platform CLI.
Dynamics 365 Sales or Customer Service.
Dataverse plug-in and PCF build processes.
PPAC-managed Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations deployments.
Azure integration services: API Management, Service Bus, Logic Apps, Functions.
Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, Log Analytics and Application Insights.
Automated testing for Power Platform or Azure deployments.
Experience at a Microsoft partner or across multiple customer tenants.
Relevant Microsoft certifications (for example AZ-400 or PL-400).

How you work

You prefer repeatable automation over undocumented manual steps.
You treat identities, permissions and secrets as part of the design.
You know a successful deployment is not necessarily a successful release.
You balance standardisation with legitimate customer-specific requirements.
You challenge unclear requirements and propose a practical first version.
You own the work from design through testing, documentation and handover.

What you get

A hands-on role shaping how Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure solutions are delivered across multiple customers.
Ownership of reusable pipeline and Infrastructure as Code standards that other teams will adopt.
Breadth across Power Platform ALM, Azure DevOps and Azure engineering.
Direct collaboration with consultants, developers and infrastructure specialists.
Competitive compensation.

Παρακολούθηση και διαχείριση vulnerabilities σε συστήματα, εφαρμογές και υποδομές.
Αυτοματοποίηση διαδικασιών security monitoring, vulnerability assessment και remediation.

Προϋπηρεσία τουλάχιστον 2 ετών σε DevOps, DevSecOps, Security DevOps ή αντίστοιχο ρόλο.

Ανταγωνιστικό πακέτο αποδοχών.

jobs.description:
Your Work Context

At Jan De Nul Group
, you will join an international and technically innovative environment where digitalization and data play an increasingly important role in offshore, dredging, and infrastructure projects. From our headquarters in Hofstade-Aalst
, you will contribute to the further development and professionalization of the Microsoft Power Platform
within the organization.

In this role, you will mainly work with technologies such as Microsoft Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Microsoft Fabric, Azure DevOps, and Git.
You will help build a scalable and secure cloud platform
that enables different teams to efficiently develop and manage applications, dashboards, and automations.

The focus of the role goes beyond the platform itself and includes stability, governance, security, and continuity. Several Power Platform initiatives are already running today, but the ambition is to further structure and expand the platform across the organization.

You will work closely with different internal teams and support colleagues in using the platform. You will have a high level of autonomy and the opportunity to help shape standards, governance, and best practices for the future development of the platform.

The position is mainly office-based in Hofstade-Aalst, with collaboration across various national and international projects.

Your Role

Within our ICT department, you will play a key role in the development and support of the Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Microsoft Fabric, etc.). You will work closely with the business and support teams in building structured, secure, and scalable solutions.

Your responsibilities include:

supporting and advising the business on the use of the Power Platform;
helping define best practices, governance, and architectural guidelines;
setting up and managing CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, Git) for Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate;
defining and maintaining deployment strategies across multiple environments (dev, test, prod);
implementing version control, backup, and lifecycle management;
establishing standards around naming conventions, policies, monitoring, and auditing;
integrating security and access management with existing IAM solutions;
ensuring secure and efficient data integration;
monitoring platform usage, performance, and adoption;
acting as a link between business, development, and infrastructure teams.

What do you need?

We are looking for a medior to senior profile with strong knowledge of the Microsoft Power Platform and a clear vision on how such platforms should be structured and managed within an organization.

You have experience with tools such as Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate and are comfortable working in Azure environments, preferably including Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and version control with Git. Knowledge of deployment strategies, lifecycle management, and governance is important for this role.

In addition, you have a good understanding of security, identity & access management, and data governance to ensure that solutions remain secure, stable, and manageable in the long term. Experience with Microsoft Fabric is considered a strong plus.

Beyond technical expertise, we are looking for someone who can work independently, takes ownership, and communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You work in a structured way, pay attention to detail, and proactively contribute ideas for improvements and standards.

A bachelor’s degree is a plus, but relevant experience and maturity are considered equally important. Dutch is required for this position.

Working at Jan De Nul

Working at Jan De Nul means helping to find solutions to some of the greatest challenges of our time: from the energy transition and rising sea levels to smart mobility. It means learning and collaborating every day, with the goal of ensuring a better quality of life worldwide for future generations.

What We Offer

A permanent training program via our JDN Academy.
The possibility to exercise at work through our FIT program.
A permanent contract with 42 paid vacation days (20 statutory, 12 ADV, and 10 public holidays).
A healthy work-life balance (flexible working hours and occasional remote work).
A competitive salary with a thirteenth month and double holiday pay, including:
Meal vouchers and eco vouchers
The opportunity to participate in the Flex Reward program, including bike and car leasing, with fuel card or charging card in Belgium
Public transport allowance and bicycle reimbursement
Group and hospitalization insurance
Option for an iPhone with subscription
Various employee discounts

You become part of an internationally growing family business.

The World Becomes What You Make Of It

Jan De Nul shapes water and land worldwide. We drive the transition to renewable energy with offshore energy infrastructure. We focus on nature-inclusive dredging solutions to build ports and protect our coastline. We develop innovative construction projects for smart mobility and sustainable buildings. And we redevelop our planet by giving polluted sites a new purpose. At Jan De Nul, the world becomes what you make of it.

Jan De Nul Group promotes diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and stand against discrimination.

at Air Apps, you will be responsible for defining and overseeing the overall system architecture
for our AI-powered platform. You will collaborate with engineering teams, product managers, and stakeholders to design scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions
that align with business objectives.

jobs.title: Senior .NET developer especializado en SQL Server, rendimiento y observabilidad
jobs.description:
El Puesto

Somos una empresa europea de software con un ERP de unos cuarenta módulos. Es un sistema con un uso intensivo de base de datos que gestiona procesos críticos con implicaciones legales.

• CAPA LEGACY: plataforma 4GL propietaria que sigue en producción. No trabajarás directamente sobre ella en este puesto.
• CAPA MODERNA: aplicación web construida con .NET 10 y Blazor Server, con SQL Server como base de datos. Aquí es donde trabajarás.

Buscamos un perfil .NET sénior a jornada completa para trabajar en nuestra aplicación web, con especial atención a SQL Server, la optimización y la observabilidad.

Es un puesto hands-on. Trabajarás junto al arquitecto responsable de la estrategia técnica, por lo que buscamos una persona sólida y resolutiva, aunque no tengas experiencia como arquitecto principal.

La aplicación web necesita mejorar su rendimiento, estabilidad y capacidad de diagnóstico. SQL Server interviene en muchos procesos de negocio y hay margen de mejora en las consultas, los patrones de acceso a datos, los índices, las transacciones, la concurrencia y la observabilidad.

Necesitamos a alguien capaz de investigar problemas reales de principio a fin, desde el código .NET hasta el plan de ejecución, e implementar soluciones medibles sin convertir cada cambio en un rediseño completo.

Responsabilidades

Analizar consultas lentas, planes de ejecución, índices, estadísticas, bloqueos, deadlocks, timeouts y consumo de recursos
Optimizar el acceso a datos desde .NET, incluidos la parametrización, la gestión de conexiones, las transacciones, la concurrencia y el tratamiento de errores
Mejorar la observabilidad de la aplicación y de SQL Server mediante logs estructurados, métricas, trazas, dashboards y alertas útiles
Investigar incidencias en producción y encontrar la causa raíz en el código, la base de datos o la interacción entre ambos
Implementar optimizaciones de forma segura, medir los resultados y evitar regresiones
Trabajar con el arquitecto y el resto del equipo para priorizar y ejecutar el roadmap técnico
Desarrollar y mantener funcionalidades de la aplicación web con C#, .NET 10 y Blazor Server

Resultados iniciales esperados

Conocimiento práctico de la aplicación web, sus workflows críticos y sus patrones de acceso a datos
Una línea base de rendimiento y observabilidad para los principales problemas de SQL Server
Primeras optimizaciones verificadas con métricas antes y después del cambio
Un backlog priorizado de mejoras en .NET, acceso a datos y SQL Server

Requisitos

Imprescindible
Experiencia profesional sólida con C# y .NET en aplicaciones web en producción
Experiencia avanzada con SQL Server, T-SQL, planes de ejecución, indexación, estadísticas y optimización de consultas
Capacidad para diagnosticar problemas de rendimiento, locking, blocking, deadlocks y concurrencia
Experiencia relacionando el comportamiento del código .NET con su impacto real en la base de datos
Criterio práctico para priorizar, implementar y validar mejoras en sistemas complejos

Se valora
Experiencia con Blazor Server y .NET 10
Experiencia con OpenTelemetry, Application Insights, Grafana, Datadog u otras herramientas de observabilidad
Experiencia con ERP, sistemas críticos o aplicaciones con un uso intensivo de base de datos
Conocimientos de CI/CD, testing de integración y análisis de regresiones de rendimiento

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Green Eagle Solutions is a leader in automating renewable energy operations, empowering energy producers to optimize their assets and trading strategies with innovative SaaS solutions. Our flagship platform, ARSOS, integrates advanced automation to enhance operational efficiency and trading performance, ensuring renewable energy producers can maximize revenue in dynamic energy markets. Join us in driving the energy transition and shaping the future of energy trading through cutting-edge automation.

Joining Green Eagle means growing alongside the company and becoming part of the transformative mindset that defines us. 🚀

If you are encouraged to do great things, join our team! 🤝💚

The challenge:

Green Eagle builds mission-critical energy optimisation systems. Our platform processes real-time telemetry from renewable assets and integrates with control centres and grid operators through industrial protocols. When it degrades, energy production is affected directly. Reliability and delivery speed are not preferences here; they are constraints we design for.
As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will build and evolve our Internal Developer Platform: the foundation that lets engineering teams ship safely, quickly and autonomously. You will design the systems, workflows and abstractions that reduce cognitive load and make reliability, security and scalability the default rather than something each team solves again on its own.
The Platform team operates as a product team, and internal engineers are your customers. Your first months will go into understanding the current infrastructure, the delivery pipelines and where teams work around the platform instead of through it. From there, your impact will come from adoption and from measurable outcomes for the teams you serve, not from the sophistication of what you build.

Our Environment:

About Air Apps

At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger- and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal, in 2018 - and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco - we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.

Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.

Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.

The Role

As a Software Architect / Solutions Architect
at Air Apps, you will be responsible for defining and overseeing the overall system architecture
for our AI-powered platform. You will collaborate with engineering teams, product managers, and stakeholders to design scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions
that align with business objectives.

You will play a key role in shaping our technology strategy, evaluating new tools and frameworks, and ensuring best practices
in software design, cloud infrastructure, and system integration.

Responsibilities

Define and maintain the overall architecture and system design for scalable and efficient software solutions.
Provide technical leadership to engineering teams, guiding them in best practices for architecture, coding, and system scalability.
Design and document high-level system diagrams, data flows, and API structures.
Evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks, and cloud services to optimize performance, security, and cost-efficiency.
Ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and security in all architectural decisions.
Oversee system integrations, including microservices, APIs, and third-party services.
Work closely with DevOps and SRE teams to ensure smooth deployment and operational reliability.
Establish coding and architecture standards, ensuring maintainability and scalability of codebases.
Identify and mitigate technical risks, ensuring system resilience and future scalability.
Conduct architecture reviews and performance audits to continuously improve system efficiency.

Requirements

Around 6+ years of experience in software development and architecture.
Strong expertise in system design, cloud computing, and microservices architecture.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform) and cloud-native architectures.
Proficiency in backend technologies (e.g., Node.js, Python, Java, .NET) and experience with modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue).
Knowledge of databases (SQL and NoSQL), caching strategies, and data pipelines.
Experience with event-driven architectures, API design, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
Strong understanding of security best practices, identity management, and encryption techniques.
Ability to evaluate trade-offs in architectural decisions, balancing scalability, cost, and complexity.
Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex architectural concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What benefits do we offer?

Apple hardware ecosystem for work.
Annual Bonus
Top-tier Health and Life Insurance for peace of mind.
Transportation Budget to support your commute needs.
Coverflex benefits package for meal allowances, well-being, and more.
Childcare support.
Air Conference - an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together.
Pension Fund to support your long-term financial planning.
Urban Sports Club membership to keep you active.

You will join the Foundry, our small software development team. We bring different areas of expertise, enjoy solving problems together and make time to help each other. We value the way people listen, learn and collaborate as much as the technical knowledge they bring.

About Our Digital Transformation

We are modernising the applications and systems that support our operations, with C#, .NET and Azure at the heart of our software environment and Microsoft Fabric supporting our data foundation.
You will contribute to a varied portfolio of digital products addressing operational and business challenges across the organisation. For example, we are building applications that help teams understand and improve workshop workflows, from welcoming a vehicle and organising maintenance to following work through to completion. We are also developing tools to analyse kilometres travelled without passengers, combining vehicle telemetry, reconciliation of planned and actual journeys, calculation logic and clear user interfaces to help teams investigate differences and identify potential savings.
These are two examples among a broader and evolving portfolio. Our products can combine operational workflows, user-facing applications, system integrations and live or frequently updated vehicle data. This can include location, energy consumption, vehicle condition and other telemetry generated by a connected fleet. The work offers opportunities to solve problems across several technical dimensions and different areas of the business.

About Your Role

You will design, build and improve digital products across the full stack, from user interfaces to backend services, APIs and application databases. Your work will include developing features used directly by operational teams, connecting existing systems and improving the reliability and usability of our applications.
You will also contribute to the shared technical foundations behind these products. This may include reusable services, integration patterns and common components that make future applications easier to build, connect and maintain. The role combines visible product development with deeper engineering work that can benefit several solutions across the organisation.
Understanding the business problem is part of the job. Working with Product Owners, Business Analysts and operational colleagues, you will explore how people work, clarify requirements and help shape practical solutions. You will consider how a change affects the wider workflow, its users and the systems around it, looking for the simplest approach that addresses the underlying need.
You will take ownership of agreed work through development, testing, deployment and production follow-up, with responsibilities suited to your experience. Our Tech Lead and colleagues will support you through code reviews, pairing and regular technical discussions.
You will have access to approved AI tools to support development, learning and exploration. We encourage you to think carefully about what can be delegated to AI, where human judgement is needed and how to verify the results. You remain responsible for understanding and testing what you deliver.

About You

You approach problems with curiosity and initiative. You want to understand why something is needed and are willing to investigate, ask questions and suggest options when requirements leave room for interpretation. You can move work forward independently while recognising when to seek guidance or validate an assumption.
You listen actively and take other people’s perspectives seriously. You bring humility to technical discussions, feel comfortable acknowledging what you do not know and can change your mind when new information reveals a better approach. You communicate progress and difficulties openly, and enjoy sharing knowledge and helping colleagues.
You have hands-on experience building applications with C# and .NET. You are familiar with web interfaces, APIs, SQL and application databases, Git, testing and debugging, and care about building software that is secure, maintainable and reliable.
Hands-on Azure experience is required. Familiarity with a modern frontend framework, Azure DevOps and CI/CD practices would be useful.
We welcome earlier-career candidates who meet the core C#, .NET and Azure requirements and demonstrate sound foundations, thoughtful problem-solving and a willingness to learn. You do not need to know every technology on day one. We want to understand how you think, work with others and develop your skills.
English is required. French and German are welcome advantages, but neither is required.

Success in This Role

Within your first year, you will have contributed useful and reliable features to our operational products and developed a strong understanding of the workflows they support. Your work will help users complete tasks more easily, understand operational issues and make better-informed decisions.
You will have contributed to both user-facing applications and the shared foundations behind them. You will identify gaps before they become problems, explain your technical choices and help the team find solutions that make sense across the wider system.
You will grow into greater technical ownership at a pace suited to your experience, contribute constructively to team discussions and build trust through dependable delivery, curiosity and collaboration.

Why Join Us

We take onboarding seriously. We will spend time introducing you to the business, the products and the people you will work with. You will learn how the team operates, who to speak with and where to find support, allowing you to build context and confidence as you take on greater responsibility.
You will join colleagues who make time to explain, discuss difficult problems and share feedback respectfully. There is room to contribute ideas, ask questions, experiment and learn from one another.
This is a permanent position where you can work on applications used in everyday transport operations, connected vehicle data and technical foundations that support several products. You will see how your work affects people’s time, the quality of their decisions and the reliability of the services they provide.
If you enjoy understanding how things work, solving problems across systems and building useful products with people who care about the outcome, we would be happy to meet you.

Luxembourg National Data Service (LNDS)
is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg’s strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation. LNDS enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner. The LNDS service portfolio includes know-how, capabilities, tools, infrastructure, and data services. Through efficient & responsible use of data and improving the secondary use of data, LNDS will support the acceleration of economic, ecological, and societal transitions.
www.lnds.lu | LNDS on LinkedIn

Purpose of the job / project

HDAB-LU: This 4-year project, which started in January 2024, aims to develop and deploy the Health Data Access Body of Luxembourg, which is the national authority responsible for granting access to health data for secondary use as set out in The European Data Governance Act (DGA) and the European Health Data Space (EHDS). Its general objective is to enable Luxembourg to establish and deploy services for its HDAB, at minimum:
processing and management of data access applications,
supporting secure processing of health data by data users,
making sure that they are well integrated in the EHDS,
establishing and aligning with EU standards,
and providing cross-border connections for large-scale deployment of HealthData@EU based on the work conducted by the joint action TEHDaS.

As an IT Infra Engineer II, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the company’s infrastructure. You will work closely with the technology team to deliver high-quality services to the HDAB's end users, including data applicants and data users seeking access to health data for secondary use. In addition, you will monitor and report on performance quality metrics and support internal and external stakeholders, including national partners and EHDS/HealthData@EU counterparts, in resolving issues.

What you will do

Help in the architecture, deployment, and improvement of cloud environments, as well as other IT infrastructures needed for the company to operate.
Collaborate across teams to transform business needs focused on public sector data secondary use into secure and relevant deployments.
Implement and ensure that the disaster recovery strategy is followed.
Evaluate and deploy new technologies and tools to keep the infrastructure relevant.
Assist to manage the Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions in place.
Deploy, configure, and maintain servers, storage systems, and networking using different configuration management tools.
Implement effective monitoring and logging solutions to proactively identify and address issues.
Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including system configurations, architectural diagrams, and compliance reports.

Who you are

Masters in a scientific, technological, or engineering discipline related to computer science, information technology, or computing.
2 to 5 years of relevant experience in designing, deploying, and maintaining complex infrastructure environments.
Must have knowledge of automation for the cloud (e.g., Terraform) and configuration of resources (e.g., Ansible, puppet).
Must have solid understanding of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS), security best practices, and firewall configurations.
Must have strong knowledge of RHEL based operating systems.
Must have knowledge of virtualization solutions such as VMware, Hyper-V, and OpenStack.
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python or Bash for automation.
Knowledge of Object-based storage solutions such as Amazon S3, Azure Blob Storage, ...
Working knowledge in cloud computing platforms such as GCP, Azure or AWS.
You have cultural intelligence and diversity consciousness.
Excellent communication skills in English.
Working knowledge of one of Luxembourg’s official languages (French, German or Luxembourgish) is a plus.
Analytical thinker, adaptive, and comfortable in interdisciplinary teams.
Culturally aware, solution-oriented, autonomous, and quality-driven.

new_jobs.title: Medior Full Stack Developer (.NET)
new_jobs.description:
Ben jij een Full Stack Developer die niet alleen enthousiast wordt van goede code, maar vooral van software die écht iets oplost voor de business? Vind je het leuk om met collega's uit verschillende onderdelen van de organisatie om tafel te gaan, processen te begrijpen en samen slimme oplossingen te bedenken? Dan zijn wij bij Amega op zoek naar jou!

Wat
ga je doen als Full Stack Developer?

Als Medior Full Stack Developer werk je aan applicaties en oplossingen binnen het Microsoft-domein. Je krijgt veel ruimte om mee te denken over zowel de technische oplossing als de vraag erachter. Je bouwt dus niet alleen wat er gevraagd wordt: je denkt mee, stelt vragen en helpt onze organisatie steeds slimmer en digitaler te werken.

Amega is continu in ontwikkeling. Binnen onze verschillende bedrijven en afdelingen zien we veel mogelijkheden om processen slimmer te maken met software en automatisering. Als Full Stack Developer speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol.

Je werkt nauw samen met collega's vanuit de business. Dat kunnen bijvoorbeeld collega's zijn uit sales, aftersales, finance, marketing of onze ondersteunende afdelingen. Samen breng je een vraagstuk terug tot de kern en vertaal je dit naar een passende softwareoplossing.

Vervolgens ben je ook zelf betrokken bij de realisatie. Van database en back-end tot gebruikersinterface: jij vindt het juist leuk om over de volle breedte van een applicatie mee te denken en te ontwikkelen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

ontwikkelen en doorontwikkelen van interne applicaties en digitale oplossingen;
vertalen van wensen en processen uit de business naar concrete softwareoplossingen;
ontwikkelen van back-endfunctionaliteit met C# en .NET;
ontwikkelen van gebruiksvriendelijke webinterfaces;
bouwen en onderhouden van API's en integraties tussen verschillende systemen;
werken met databases, bijvoorbeeld Microsoft SQL Server;
meedenken over architectuur, kwaliteit, security en onderhoudbaarheid;
testen, reviewen en verbeteren van bestaande software;
signaleren van mogelijkheden om processen verder te automatiseren.

Je werkt daarbij niet vanaf een eiland. Juist het contact met gebruikers en collega's vinden we belangrijk. Soms begint je werk met een technisch vraagstuk, maar net zo vaak met een gesprek als: “We doen dit nu iedere dag handmatig, kan dat niet slimmer?” Daar krijg jij energie van.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij Amega krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de verdere professionalisering van onze softwareontwikkeling. Je werkt in een organisatie waar veel gebeurt en waar digitalisering volop in ontwikkeling is. Daarnaast bieden wij jou:

veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief: Zie jij een betere technische oplossing of een kans om iets slimmer te organiseren? Dan horen we dat graag.
direct contact met de business: Je ziet voor wie je software maakt en ervaart ook daadwerkelijk wat jouw oplossing oplevert.
veel afwisseling: Door de diversiteit binnen Amega kom je in aanraking met uiteenlopende processen, systemen en vraagstukken.
hybride werken: Je combineert werken vanuit onze locatie in Dordrecht met thuiswerken.
ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Ruimte om jezelf technisch én persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen door opleidingen, trainingen en praktijkervaring.
werken binnen het Microsoft-domein: Je werkt met technologie zoals .NET, C# en Microsoft SQL Server.
korte lijnen: Je werkt in een organisatie waarin je gemakkelijk kunt schakelen met collega's, management en andere afdelingen.
een marktconform salaris en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.
een informele werksfeer met enthousiaste collega's en een organisatie waarin samenwerken centraal staat.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

We zoeken geen developer die het liefst de hele dag met een koptelefoon op alleen tickets wegwerkt. Natuurlijk vinden we technische kennis belangrijk, maar minstens zo belangrijk vinden we jouw nieuwsgierigheid naar de organisatie achter de software.

Je wilt begrijpen hoe processen werken, waarom gebruikers bepaalde wensen hebben en hoe technologie hen écht verder kan c.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

HBO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld richting Informatica, Software Engineering of vergelijkbaar;
enkele jaren relevante ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar;
goede kennis van C# en .NET;
ervaring met webontwikkeling, zowel back-end als front-end;
ervaring met API's, integraties en databases;
ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server;
ervaring met Git en moderne ontwikkelprocessen;
je schrijft graag duidelijke, onderhoudbare en goed testbare software;
je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en denkt graag in oplossingen;
je communiceert gemakkelijk met zowel technische als niet-technische collega's;
je vindt het leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen van vraagstuk tot werkende oplossing.

Je hoeft niet ieder onderdeel van onze technische omgeving al volledig te beheersen. We vinden het belangrijker dat je een goede technische basis hebt, breed geïnteresseerd bent en graag nieuwe technologie en bedrijfsprocessen leert kennen.

Hier kom je te werken

Je komt te werken binnen de ICT-organisatie van Amega in Dordrecht. Amega is een grote en groeiende automotive dealerholding waarin verschillende bedrijven en disciplines samenwerken rondom mobiliteit.

Die diversiteit maakt jouw werk als developer juist interessant. Achter onze organisatie zitten allerlei processen rondom auto's, klanten, werkplaatsen, verkoop, mobiliteit, finance en dienstverlening. En overal liggen mogelijkheden om met slimme software het verschil te maken.

Binnen ICT werken we samen aan het ondersteunen én verder ontwikkelen van de organisatie. Daarbij willen we steeds meer zelf kunnen bouwen, automatiseren en integreren.

Als Full Stack Developer krijg jij de kans om daarin vanaf het begin mee te denken en zichtbaar bij te dragen.

Waarom deze functie bij Amega?

Omdat je hier niet alleen aan software werkt.

Je werkt aan oplossingen waarvan je vaak letterlijk een paar dagen later van een collega kunt horen wat ze hebben opgeleverd. Je krijgt de ruimte om de business in te gaan, vragen te stellen en samen iets nieuws neer te zetten.

Dus ben jij een Full Stack Developer die graag code combineert met nieuwsgierigheid naar mensen, processen en business?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Waarom kiezen voor Amega?

Werken met de gaafste automerken!
Sluit je aan bij een groeiend en succesvol bedrijf
Grootste automotive dealerholding in de regio
Financieel sterkste automotive bedrijf van Nederland
Professionele en positieve familiesfeer waardoor medewerkers gemiddeld 10,5 jaar bij ons blijven werken

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

You will lead architecture design, drive technology decisions, and co-create innovative products while mentoring clients to adopt Agile practices and engineering excellence. Your work offers hands-on collaboration, diverse industry exposure, and opportunities to shape solutions and grow as a technology leader.

You will lead project workstreams, drive architectural decisions, and build scalable solutions using Agile methodologies. Working closely with client teams, you will co-create products, foster a culture of engineering excellence, and mentor teams in best practices. Your responsibilities will include shaping technical strategies, making key technology decisions, and ensuring the delivery of impactful, user-centric solutions.

Your work will have a lasting impact beyond the products you build. By collaborating with client leadership, you will influence their digital strategies, help scale their engineering cultures, and enable them to achieve sustainable growth. Each project will expose you to diverse industries and technologies, providing opportunities to learn and grow while shaping the future of technology.

You will design and deliver next-generation products that transform businesses across industries. Based in one of our global locations, you will be part of QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey, a multidisciplinary group of software engineers, AI engineers, data scientists, and technology consultant passionate about creating industry-shaping products and tools.

Your role offers unparalleled opportunities for growth and innovation. You’ll have a seat at the table with client leaders, the chance to shape product strategies, and the freedom to explore areas of personal interest. Bachelors, Master’s or PhD level degree in a discipline such as: computer science, machine learning, applied statistics, mathematics, engineering or artificial intelligence
7+ years of experience in software development, with significant full-stack web application development experience strongly preferred
Experience working collaboratively with technical and non-technical team members and stakeholders

Experience with LLM frameworks, prompt orchestration, agent frameworks, MCPs, evaluation frameworks, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), including Docker and CI/CD
Strong focus on automated testing, logging, monitoring, and overall system reliability
Experience modeling and coaching others to use engineering best practices such as design patterns, customer-centric design, test-driven development, code refactoring, code review, and OWASP Top 10 security awareness
Experience leading in Agile teams, including coaching and modeling Agile mindsets as part of sprint ceremonies, work definition and building developer capabilities
Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English, with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels

new_jobs.description:
This is an opportunity to work with an Ashoka Staff

This is an unpaid, volunteer opportunity

About The Affiliated Organization

Founded in 1980, Ashoka pioneered the field of social entrepreneurship. We are now the largest association of leading social entrepreneurs in the world, a network of 4000+ Ashoka Fellows in 99 countries at work creating systemic change on the most pressing social and environmental issues of our time. We find, support and collaborate with our Fellows to help scale their solutions across nations and continents and work with a wide range of partners to create an "Everyone a Changemaker" world, one in which we all can find and develop our power to create meaningful change for the good of all.

For more information, please visit www.ashoka.org

Job Description

Ashoka is looking for senior-level professionals in Web Design, Development and Tech Support who can provide our Fellows with professional consults and project based support. We are creating an elite team of 10-15 members from different world regions (to reflect cultural contexts and language) in this field and in seven others of similarly high-value skillsets. We are calling these members Ashoka Professional Support Partners (PSPs) rather than "volunteers" to reflect the expertise and commitment to impact they will bring to our global community.

As an Ashoka Support Partner your expertise will be promoted to Fellows over the course of two to three months. If there is a need that meets your interests and availability, an introduction will be made so that you can learn more details about the support partnership and ways that you can contribute. Until that time your name and contact details will be held confidentially to protect your privacy.

As a Member Of The Web Design, Development And Tech Solutions Team You Will Be Working At The Intersection Of Digital Craft, Social-enterprise Literacy, And Capacity-building. Our Ashoka Fellows Are Leading Social Entrepreneurs Running Organizations That Often Need Stronger Digital Foundations To Scale Their Impact. A Senior Professional On This Team Would Help To Secure

Website security and vulnerability management
Backup and disaster recovery planning
Cloud platform management
AI-ready content architecture (good to have!)

Some of the CRM and Constituent systems fellows may need would be:

Salesforce
Microsoft Dynamics
HubSpot
Donor management systems
Constituent relationship managemen

Beyond the website itself, fellows would probably need support in the following technology areas:

Marketing Technology Stack ( Email marketing, campaigns, marketing automation etc)
Global reach (internationalization, localization, translation management, right to left language support)
Performance Engineering (Core Web Vitals, CDN strategies etc)
Mobile performance (this could actually be very crucial for fellows in emerging markets where most of their marketing will happen on Mobile platforms)
Platform Governance and Strategy (editorial permissions architecture, platform sustainability etc)

To summarize what is added above, it could help to have the following:

Experience with modern web architecture, security, performance optimization, AI-ready content systems, structured data, and advanced SEO/discoverability practices.
Demonstrated expertise in website security, accessibility, multilingual implementations, cloud hosting environments, and scalable content management architectures.
Build or rebuild Fellow and Fellow-led organizations' websites — from strategy and information architecture through design, development, and launch — so Fellows can credibly tell their story, recruit supporters, and raise funds online.
Design brand-aligned digital experiences — visual identity, UI/UX, landing pages, donation/fundraising flows, and campaign microsites that reflect each Fellow's mission and audience.
Modernize and maintain existing sites — auditing, migrating, and upgrading legacy platforms applying rigor to Fellows' sites.
Integrate essential nonprofit tooling — connecting sites to CRM/donor systems, email platforms, payment/donation processors, analytics, and multilingual/localization support for Fellows working across regions.
Coach and build Fellow capacity — transferring skills to Fellows and their teams so they can update content, run campaigns, and sustain their digital presence independently rather than depending on outside help indefinitely.

Please let us know today if you'd like to join this small but mighty team! You will be deeply appreciated and never taken for granted!

Volunteer Logistics

Estimated hours required per week: 5-10

The estimated duration of the project is: 1-3 months

This position is Virtual (Remote)

Language Requirements

English, other Languages a big plus

Desired Skills And Experience

8+ years of progressively responsible web design, development and tech solutions experience, including at least 3 years in a senior or lead role (leading builds, mentoring, or owning architecture decisions).
A demonstrated portfolio of live websites spanning design through deployment, ideally including nonprofit, multilingual, or multi-site/multi-region projects.
Proven experience working remotely in distributed, cross-cultural teams.
Strong command of user-centered design, information architecture, and visual/brand design principles.
Proficiency in design tools (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite) and prototyping.
Understanding of accessibility, responsive/mobile-first design, and performance. Development skills Front-end: HTML5, CSS3, modern JavaScript, and a framework such as React.
Back-end and CMS fluency — especially Drupal and/or WordPress, with experience in theming, custom modules, and migrations.
Experience integrating third-party systems (Salesforce/CRM, donation platforms, email tools) and working with APIs.
Familiarity with cloud hosting and DevOps basics and basic SEO/analytics setup.
Literacy in social entrepreneurship and systems-change work, so digital solutions serve mission and scale rather than just looking polished.
Experience with budget-conscious, resource-light environments typical of early-stage Fellow organizations.
Intercultural fluency to work across countries and multilingual contexts, with strong English (additional languages a plus).
A coaching, capacity-strengthening mindset — willingness to teach and document, not just deliver.

Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Berlin – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

You will join one of our product teams and on a daily basis:

Design, develop, test, and ship robust, maintainable, and readable software, applications, APIs, and other workflows
Initiate, participate in, and communicate technical architecture designs
Attend regular scrum ceremonies as a member of an agile cross-functional team
Analyze, discuss, and implement business requirements while maintaining good documentation of the systems and components you create
Bring in industry standards and best practices to continually improve our codebase and architecture
Make a positive impact on our engineering culture by adopting, implementing, and providing feedback on both organisational and industry standards and practices

Qualifications

What you bring:

Hands-on experience with C# and the .NET framework, with a minimum of 5 years of experience
Experience in developing, shipping, and maintaining cloud-based applications
Good knowledge and experience working with microservices and distributed architectures
A deep understanding and knowledge of RESTful APIs
Years of experience using relational databases, preferably SQL Server. Additionally, working knowledge of ORMs, preferably Entity Framework
Familiarity with cloud development; experience with Azure is a bonus
Practical knowledge of using messaging platforms in a distributed architecture (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka)
Knowledge and experience on a FinTech and banking industry is a plus
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, and sound judgement about reviewing and testing what they produce, is a plus
Fluent English

Please note
: you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Germany.

About The Technologies We Use

Our teams have autonomy when it comes to tech choices. The example below will give you some insights, and we are looking forward to discussing this further with you.

All solutions developed cloud-native targeting Azure - Infrastructure defined using Terraform - Services deployed to Kubernetes clusters by default - A growing microservice ecosystem with event-based integration - Using latest .NET Core - RESTful API design - Single-page frontend apps served by CDN - Frontend tech using TypeScript, often Angular or standard Web Components (Stencil) - Automated tests in each layer.

new_jobs.description:
Werde Teil unseres Teams

Als Backend-Entwickler .NET / C# (w/m/d) bei der SP Consult AG bist Du das Fundament unserer Software: Du entwickelst robuste, skalierbare und sichere Server-Anwendungen, Schnittstellen und Datenbanklösungen, die auch bei großen Events zuverlässig laufen. Bei uns erwarten Dich spannende technische Herausforderungen, ein starker Teamzusammenhalt und echte Verantwortung für das, was Du baust.

Das sind Deine Aufgaben

Du planst, entwickelst und implementierst eigenverantwortlich neue Backend-Module, Services und APIs für unsere Warenwirtschafts- und Ticketing-Lösung im Sport- und Freizeitbereich.
Du pflegst, optimierst und modernisierst bestehende Softwarekomponenten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem gesamten Entwicklungs- und Vertriebsteam.
Du entwirfst und optimierst Datenbankstrukturen und Abfragen mit Blick auf Performance, Stabilität und Datensicherheit.
Du analysierst neue Kundenanforderungen und entwickelst daraus Lösungen mit echtem Mehrwert für das Gesamtsystem.
Du sicherst die Codequalität durch automatisierte Tests und Code Reviews.
Du arbeitest mit uns im Team nach dem Prinzip „You build it, you run it”

Das solltest Du mitbringen

Deine Hardware:

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium oder eine IT-Ausbildung absolviert, beispielsweise als Fachinformatiker (w/m/d) für Anwendungsentwicklung. Alternativ hast Du Dir Dein Know-how auf anderem Weg angeeignet und bringst langjährige praktische Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung mit. Für uns zählt, was Du kannst, nicht wie Du es gelernt hast.
Du hast nachweisbare Berufserfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit C# und .NET, idealerweise mit ASP.NET Core, und hast bereits an produktiv eingesetzter Software mitgearbeitet.
Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse relationaler Datenbanken (MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL oder vergleichbar) sowie idealerweise über Erfahrung mit ORM-Frameworks wie dem Entity Framework.
Nice-to-have: DevOps-Erfahrung, insbesondere mit Kubernetes (K8s), Docker und CI/CD-Pipelines, oder die Bereitschaft, Dich darin einzuarbeiten sowie Erfahrungen mit webbasierten Anwendungen auf Basis von Microsoft ASP.NET, JavaScript und Bootstrap.

Deine Software

Du analysierst komplexe Probleme strukturiert und entwickelst pragmatische, nachhaltige Lösungen.

Du hast Freude an Zusammenarbeit, Wissensaustausch und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

Du arbeitest selbstständig, bringst eigene Ideen ein und gestaltest Prozesse aktiv mit.
Sauberer, wartbarer Code ist für Dich selbstverständlich.

Du verständigst Dich sicher auf Deutsch, mindestens auf B2-Niveau. Gute Englischkenntnisse, vor allem im technischen Bereich, sind ein Plus.

Nicht alles passt perfekt? Kein Problem – wir setzen auf Einsatz, Leidenschaft und Teamfit statt auf starre Kriterien.

Das bieten wir Dir

Wir lieben Vielfalt. Wir arbeiten in einem offenen Arbeitsumfeld auf Augenhöhe. Diversität ist für uns gelebte Realität, genauso wie unsere Duz-Kultur.
Ein Team, das zusammenhält. Wir glauben an eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein Klima, in dem jede:r gehört wird.
Weiterbildung, die zu Dir passt. Bedarfsorientierte Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und regelmäßiger, konstruktiver Austausch gehören bei uns dazu.
Feelgood-Atmosphäre inklusive. Denn Dein Wohlbefinden ist uns wichtig. Frisches Obst und Getränke am Arbeitsplatz, sowie unser nagelneuer Team Space mit Fitnessgeräten, Billardtisch, Dartbereich und Fahrsimulator sollen dazu beitragen.
Mitarbeiter-E-Bike. Du hältst Dich auf dem Weg zur Arbeit fit und tust gleichzeitig der Umwelt was Gutes? Wir unterstützen Dich dabei mit einem E-Bike-Leasingangebot per Entgeltumwandlung.
Gemeinsame Erlebnisse. Ob Team-Events, Weihnachtsfeier, Sommerfest oder sportliche Aktivitäten - wir feiern Erfolge und Erlebnisse am liebsten gemeinsam.
Flexibles Arbeiten. Mobiles Arbeiten beziehungsweise Homeoffice ist bei uns nach Absprache möglich.
Weitere Benefits. Ein Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge sowie attraktive Corporate Benefits erwarten Dich.

Über uns

Die SP Consult AG
ist ein erfahrenes IT-Unternehmen, das komplexe Web-Applikationen für Kunden im Profisport, Freizeitbereich und der Versicherungswirtschaft entwickelt und betreibt. Gemeinsam mit unserem Schwesterunternehmen LMS Sport
realisieren wir responsive Online-Shops für Event-Ticketing und Merchandising, die nahtlos in ERP-, CRM- und Warenwirtschafts-Backoffice-Lösungen integriert sind.

Als Teil der Manos Holding AG bildet die SP Consult AG gemeinsam mit unseren Schwestergesellschaften LMS Sport GmbH, Novantis Service GmbH und Reservix GmbH ein starkes Netzwerk am Standort Duisburg. Was uns verbindet? Die Leidenschaft für Service, Events, Sport und digitale Lösungen.

Die Unternehmen der Manos Holding AG sind mit rund 500 engagierten Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern an mehreren Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich vertreten. Darunter Berlin, Düsseldorf, Duisburg, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Leipzig, Oldenburg und Wien.

Für die SP Consult AG am Standort Duisburg suchen wir ab sofort Verstärkung.

(Die Schaltung unserer offenen Stellen erfolgt parallel auch über unsere Schwestergesellschaften LMS Sport GmbH und Reservix GmbH)

Sie wirken maßgeblich an der technischen Integration unserer SAP-Systemlandschaft mit modernen Cloud-, Automatisierungs- und KI-Plattformen mit. Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Entwicklung, Erweiterung und Anbindung von SAP-Schnittstellen, insbesondere auf Basis von OData- und REST-Services.

Darüber hinaus besitzen Sie erste Kenntnisse in der Softwareentwicklung, insbesondere mit Python, SQL, C+++ oder ABAP.

new_jobs.description:
Equal IT are hiring for a small, sharp engineering team building enterprise-level products used by some pretty big brands and agencies.

The team is hybrid and based in Stockholm.

There are two tracks open right now for frontend-heavy or backend-heavy,
and we are happy to speak to strong engineers on either side.

What matters more than the stack is how you work.

We are looking for someone who drives things forward, someone who pushes back on scope when it makes sense, leads the technical conversation, and makes the engineers around them better.

AI is part of the picture too, not feaure-lead but embedded in engineering workflow. We want to hear about what you have actually done. Real AI workflows, real guardrails, real examples of where something went wrong and what you did about it.

Frontend-heavy

We are looking for someone who is genuinely strong in frontend architecture, not just someone who makes things look good.
Angular experience is ideal, or something close enough.
You will also need enough backend experience to comfortably cross over when needed.

Backend-heavy

Strong .NET/C# experience, with real production scale behind you.
Microservices, distributed systems, systems running under load. Stuff you have built and operated.
You do not need to be a frontend specialist, but you should be able to hold your own when you need to jump across.

The engineering culture is collaborative and consensus-driven, which we like. But consensus doesn’t mean everyone agreeing for the sake of it. We want someone comfortable taking a position, defending it, and changing their mind when the evidence says they should.

If that sounds like you, we’d be interested in talking.

new_jobs.description:
Build secure, scalable software as a consultant across defense, automotive, and telecom. Whether your strength is .NET, C++, applications, or Azure, we’d like to hear from you.

Your assignments will vary in technology, scope, and working setup. Depending on the project, you may work at a client’s site, from a Knowit office, or remotely. The solutions range from consumer products to complex industrial systems, giving you opportunities to apply your experience across different technical domains.

You might build scalable backend services in C# and .NET, develop applications, work with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, or solve challenges closer to industrial systems. Some assignments involve environments with high security requirements, including the defense industry.

Collaboration and knowledge sharing are central to the role. You will work alongside colleagues and clients, take responsibility for your delivery, and contribute ideas throughout the development process. As your interests and expertise evolve, you can explore new technologies and develop in a direction that makes sense for you.

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

You are an experienced software developer with expertise in one or more of the following areas:

Software development in C# and .NET.
Development in C++.
Backend or application development.
Cloud platforms, preferably Azure and the Microsoft ecosystem.
Testing at the unit, integration, or system level.
Development in environments with high security requirements, such as the defense industry.

We do not expect you to match every item. What matters is that you can contribute solid development experience, enjoy working with others, and take responsibility for your work. Curiosity and a willingness to keep learning will help you thrive as technologies, assignments, and customer needs evolve.

What can you expect from us?

Professional development is part of everyday work. In addition to courses and formal training, you will build knowledge through collaboration, workshops, seminars, and conversations with colleagues from different technical backgrounds.

Close dialogue with your manager helps shape assignments that support your experience, interests, and continued growth. You will have room to explore new technologies, share ideas, and influence how we work.

You will join an inclusive workplace that values openness, community, and continuous improvement. We also recognize the importance of a healthy balance between work and personal life. Workshops, seminars, after-work gatherings, and other shared activities provide opportunities to connect both professionally and socially.

Application

Does this sound like a place where your experience and curiosity could make a difference? Send us your application and tell us which areas of software development interest you most. We look forward to learning more about you.

About Knowit

Work with us at Knowit Connectivity, where we develop technically advanced systems within embedded and connected solutions. With us, you will work on complex products alongside experienced engineers on assignments at the forefront of technology.

Knowit is a Nordic consultancy that helps companies, public sector organizations, and businesses succeed in digital transformation. With expertise in software development, AI, cybersecurity, cloud services, digital customer experiences, and management consulting, we create solutions that contribute to a more sustainable and human-centered society.

We are approximately 3,700 employees working across our business areas – Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight, and Products – primarily in the Nordics, as well as in Poland, Serbia, and Germany.

We don’t wait for the future. We build it.
